/* ---------- crkva (P3.1): žuta „kockasta“. POZICIJA JE PROCENA (nema podatka u izvoru, D4); sa kolizijom i ulazom na E ---------- */
var CHURCH={estimated:true,street:'Tanasija Mihajlovića Španca',x:0,z:0,door:[0,1],found:false,spot:null,house:null};
var R2CH_V0=-1.9,R2CH_V1=19.7,R2CH_U=5.3;   // otisak: širina ±5,3 m; dubina od stepenica (v=-1,9) do apside (v=19,7)
function r2ChurchMap(sp){const iv=sp.dz?[0,-sp.sg]:[-sp.sg,0],uv=[iv[1],-iv[0]];
  return {iv,uv,sw:!sp.dz,wx:(u,v)=>sp.x+uv[0]*u+iv[0]*v,wz:(u,v)=>sp.z+uv[1]*u+iv[1]*v}}
function r2ChurchScore(sp,near){const M=r2ChurchMap(sp);let lo=1e9,hi=-1e9,sc=0;
  for(const u of [-R2CH_U,0,R2CH_U])for(const v of [R2CH_V0,9,R2CH_V1]){const y=height(M.wx(u,v),M.wz(u,v));lo=Math.min(lo,y);hi=Math.max(hi,y)}
  if(hi-lo>3.2)return 99;
  for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++)for(let j=0;j<=6;j++){const u=i*(R2CH_U+1)/2,v=R2CH_V0-1+j*(R2CH_V1-R2CH_V0+2)/6,px=M.wx(u,v),pz=M.wz(u,v);
    if(nearestRoad(px,pz).d<2.6)sc++;
    for(const h of near)if(pointInside(px,pz,h.poly)){sc+=2;break}}
  return sc}
function r2ChurchSpot(){
  const rd=roads.filter(r=>r.name===CHURCH.street);if(!rd.length)return null;let best=null;const t0=performance.now();
  for(const off of [14,18,22,26,30,36,42,50])for(const r of rd){const P=r.p;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){
    const a=P[i-1],b=P[i],L=hyp(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(L<4)continue;
    const nx=-(b[1]-a[1])/L,nz=(b[0]-a[0])/L,N=Math.max(1,Math.floor(L/4));
    for(let q=0;q<N;q++){const t=(q+.5)/N,mx=lerp(a[0],b[0],t),mz=lerp(a[1],b[1],t);
      for(const s of [1,-1]){const x=mx+nx*off*s,z=mz+nz*off*s,dx=-nx*s,dzv=-nz*s,dz=Math.abs(dzv)>=Math.abs(dx),sg=Math.sign(dz?dzv:dx)||1;
        const near=houses.filter(h=>hyp(h.c[0]-x,h.c[1]-z)<70),c={x,z,dz,sg},sc=r2ChurchScore(c,near)+off*.002;
        if(!best||sc<best.sc){best={...c,sc};if(sc<.2){best.ms=performance.now()-t0;return best}}}}}}
  if(best)best.ms=performance.now()-t0;
  return best&&best.sc<=4?best:null}
function r2ChurchCollider(){   // zove se iz rebuildColliders(): crkva je puna zgrada + vrata za E
  if(!CHURCH)return;const sp=CHURCH.spot||(CHURCH.spot=r2ChurchSpot());if(!sp)return;
  const M=r2ChurchMap(sp),U=R2CH_U,pts=[[-U,R2CH_V0],[U,R2CH_V0],[U,R2CH_V1],[-U,R2CH_V1],[-U,R2CH_V0]].map(q=>[M.wx(q[0],q[1]),M.wz(q[0],q[1])]);
  const bd=polyBounds(pts);if(!CHURCH.house)CHURCH.house={church:true,name:'Crkva',poly:pts,rings:[pts],bound:bd,c:[(bd[0]+bd[2])/2,(bd[1]+bd[3])/2],floors:4,height:12,sourceId:'kb-crkva-procena',osm:false,door:{x:M.wx(0,-3.6),z:M.wz(0,-3.6)}};
  CHURCH.x=sp.x;CHURCH.z=sp.z;CHURCH.door=[-M.iv[0],-M.iv[1]];CHURCH.found=true;try{window.KB_CHURCH=CHURCH}catch(e){}
  r2LazaPick();
  addCollider({kind:'building',house:CHURCH.house,rings:[pts],bound:bd})}
function r2Church(m){
  const sp=CHURCH.spot||(CHURCH.spot=r2ChurchSpot());if(!sp){console.warn('[KB] crkva: nema mesta (procena)');return}
  const M=r2ChurchMap(sp),sw=M.sw,wx=M.wx,wz=M.wz;
  CHURCH.x=sp.x;CHURCH.z=sp.z;CHURCH.door=[-M.iv[0],-M.iv[1]];CHURCH.found=true;console.log('[KB] crkva (PROCENA) x='+sp.x.toFixed(1)+' z='+sp.z.toFixed(1)+' trazenje '+Math.round(sp.ms||0)+' ms');try{window.KB_CHURCH=CHURCH}catch(e){}
  let base=-1e9;for(const u of [-5,5])for(const v of [0,10,19])base=Math.max(base,height(wx(u,v),wz(u,v)));
  const B=(u,y,v,w,h,d,c,t)=>m.box(wx(u,v),base+y,wz(u,v),sw?d:w,h,sw?w:d,c,t),P=(u,y,v)=>[wx(u,v),base+y,wz(u,v)];
  const WALL='#e9c94f',TRIM='#f4e7b8',ROOF='#8b3a2b',STONE='#9b958a',WOOD='#4a3524',GLASS='#2d3f5a',GOLD='#d9c27a';
  B(0,-.5,9.6,10,2.2,19.8,STONE,0);
  B(0,3.6,10.9,9,6,11,WALL,1);
  B(0,6.1,2.7,5.4,11,5.4,WALL,1);
  B(0,2.9,17.8,5.6,4.6,2.8,WALL,1);B(0,5.35,17.8,6,.3,3.2,ROOF,2);
  m.quad(P(-5,6.5,5.2),P(-5,6.5,16.6),P(0,9.6,16.6),P(0,9.6,5.2),ROOF,2);
  m.quad(P(5,6.5,5.2),P(0,9.6,5.2),P(0,9.6,16.6),P(5,6.5,16.6),ROOF,2);
  m.tri(P(-4.5,6.6,16.45),P(4.5,6.6,16.45),P(0,9.4,16.45),WALL,1);
  const c=[[-3,-.3],[3,-.3],[3,5.7],[-3,5.7]];
  for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const a=c[k],b=c[(k+1)%4];m.tri(P(a[0],11.5,a[1]),P(b[0],11.5,b[1]),P(0,17.8,2.7),ROOF,2)}
  B(0,18.9,2.7,.22,2.2,.22,GOLD,0);B(0,19.2,2.7,1.1,.22,.22,GOLD,0);
  B(0,.2,-.9,3.2,.8,1.8,STONE,0);B(0,1.9,-.03,2.5,3,.08,TRIM,1);B(0,1.9,-.1,1.9,2.6,.14,WOOD,3);
  B(0,8.6,-.06,1.4,2.3,.1,GLASS,0);
  for(const u of [-.62,.62])roundBone(m,P(u,7.49,-.16),P(u,9.09,-.16),.086,TRIM,.08,1,8);
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/10,b=(i+1)*Math.PI/10;
    roundBone(m,P(Math.cos(a)*.62,9.09+Math.sin(a)*.68,-.16),P(Math.cos(b)*.62,9.09+Math.sin(b)*.68,-.16),.083,TRIM,.083,1,6);}
  for(const [y1,y2,r1,r2] of [[8.92,8.75,.13,.32],[8.75,8.33,.32,.41],[8.33,8.23,.41,.51]])
    roundBone(m,P(0,y1,-.22),P(0,y2,-.22),r1,'#94734b',r2,0,12);
  m.sphere(...P(0,8.20,-.24),.11,.14,.11,'#584737',0);B(0,2.64,-.19,.12,.54,.08,GOLD,0);B(0,2.70,-.20,.36,.085,.08,GOLD,0);
  for(const v of [7.4,10.4,13.4])for(const s of [-1,1]){B(s*4.51,3.7,v,.1,2.7,1.4,TRIM,1);B(s*4.53,3.7,v,.12,2.4,1.1,GLASS,3)}
}

/* ---------- Lazina kuća (P3.2): IZMIŠLJENA fasada i unutrašnjost, bez kućnog broja; zgrada se bira heš-om (source_id) uz ulicu crkve ---------- */
var LAZA={house:null,door:null,c:null,sourceId:null,strict:true,flags:{}};
function r2LazaPick(){
  if(LAZA.house||!CHURCH||!CHURCH.spot)return;const c0=[CHURCH.spot.x,CHURCH.spot.z];let best=null;try{window.KB_LAZA=LAZA}catch(e){}
  const D={n:houses.length,near:0,area:0,street:0};
  for(const strict of [true,false]){
    for(const h of houses){
      if(h.hero||h.church||h.poly.length<5)continue;
      const d=hyp(h.c[0]-c0[0],h.c[1]-c0[1]);if(d<30||d>130)continue;if(strict)D.near++;
      const ar=r2Area(h.poly);if(ar<45||ar>170)continue;if(strict)D.area++;
      const nr=nearestRoad(h.c[0],h.c[1]);if(!nr.p)continue;
      if(strict){if(nr.road&&nr.road.name===CHURCH.street&&nr.d<=22)D.street++;else continue}
      const k=r2Hash(String(h.sourceId||('c'+Math.round(h.c[0]*10)+','+Math.round(h.c[1]*10))),7);if(!best||k<best.k)best={h,k,rp:nr.p}}
    if(best){LAZA.strict=strict;break}}
  LAZA.dbg=D;if(!best)return;const h=best.h,P=h.poly.slice(0,-1);
  let edge=null,bd=1e9;for(let k=0;k<P.length;k++){const a=P[k],b=P[(k+1)%P.length];if(hyp(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])<3.2)continue;const m=[(a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2],dd=hyp(m[0]-best.rp[0],m[1]-best.rp[1]);if(dd<bd){bd=dd;edge=m}}
  if(!edge)return;const dx=edge[0]-h.c[0],dz=edge[1]-h.c[1],L=hyp(dx,dz)||1;
  h.door={x:edge[0]+dx/L*.7,z:edge[1]+dz/L*.7};h.laza=true;LAZA.house=h;LAZA.door=h.door;LAZA.c=h.c;LAZA.sourceId=h.sourceId||null;
  console.log('[KB] Lazina kuca (IZMISLJENA, izbor po hesu) x='+h.c[0].toFixed(1)+' z='+h.c[1].toFixed(1)+(LAZA.strict?'':' (bez uslova ulice)'))}
function r2LazaInterior(){const m=Mesh();
  m.box(0,-.18,0,15,.35,14,'#8a6a49',3);
  m.box(-7.45,2.9,0,.3,5.8,14,'#bcd3c4',1);m.box(7.45,2.9,0,.3,5.8,14,'#bcd3c4',1);m.box(0,2.9,-6.95,15,5.8,.3,'#c9dccd',1);m.box(0,5.9,0,15,.25,14,'#d9d2c3');
  m.box(-4,2.5,-6.7,2.9,2.5,.14,'#477685');m.box(-4,2.5,-6.55,.12,2.4,.18,'#eee9d6');m.box(-4,2.5,-6.55,2.9,.11,.18,'#eee9d6');
  m.box(0,3.8,7,15,2,.3,'#c5bcae',1);m.box(-5.1,1.9,7,.3,3.9,.3,'#c5bcae',1);m.box(5.1,1.9,7,.3,3.9,.3,'#c5bcae',1);
  m.box(0,.03,0,5.2,.05,4.2,'#9a4a3a',3);
  m.box(3.2,1,-2.2,3.2,.16,1.9,'#8b5e3c',3);for(const q of [[1.7,-1.4],[4.7,-1.4],[1.7,-3],[4.7,-3]])m.box(q[0],.5,q[1],.18,1,.18,'#6e4a2f',3);
  for(const q of [[3.2,-.7],[3.2,-3.7],[1.3,-2.2],[5.1,-2.2]])m.box(q[0],.42,q[1],.62,.84,.62,'#a57a52',3);
  m.box(3.2,1.28,-2.2,.9,.4,.32,'#2d2d2f');m.box(3.55,1.75,-2.2,.05,.7,.05,'#aaaaaa');
  m.box(6.2,1,-5.4,1.7,2,1.5,'#34343a',3);m.box(6.2,2.05,-5.4,1.7,.08,1.5,'#555555');m.box(6.2,3.9,-5.9,.42,3.8,.42,'#26262a');
  for(const y of [1.6,2.5,3.4]){m.box(-7.05,y,-3.2,.5,.1,4.2,'#6e4d33',3);for(let i=0;i<5;i++)m.box(-7.05,y+.28,-4.8+i*.8,.36,.45,.5,['#a65d4a','#4f7a6b','#c9a24a','#5d6fa6','#8a4f8a'][i],3)}
  m.box(-5.2,.55,3.4,3.4,.9,1.7,'#5f7186',3);m.box(-5.2,1.1,4,3.4,.9,.4,'#5f7186',3);m.box(-6.4,1.05,3,.9,.25,.6,'#e5ddc8',3);
  m.box(-.6,3.3,-6.78,1.5,1.05,.07,'#5a4636',3);m.box(-.6,3.3,-6.72,1.2,.8,.07,'#b9a98a');
  furnishRoom(m,false);return m.out}
function r2LazaAnswer(k,reply,note){if(!cine)cine=newCine();LAZA.flags.answer=k;cine.flags.lazaAnswer=k;cine.flags.lazaTrust=(k==='iskreno');cine.flags.lazaRadio=(k==='radio');say('Laza',reply,6);archive('laza','Razgovor sa Lazom (izmišljeno)',note)}
function r2LazaEnter(){
  if(!cine)cine=newCine();
  if(cine.flags.lazaAnswer){conversation([['Laza','Opet ti. Sedi, kafa je još topla.',4]]);return}
  conversation([['Laza','Uđi, uđi, sedi. Nemoj da stojiš na vratima.',4],['Laza','Čuo sam da si bio kod stanice. Šta si tamo tražio?',5]]);
  offerDecision('Laza čeka odgovor',[
    {label:'Tražio sam signal.',detail:'Poveri mu se. Laza ti veruje, ali zna više nego što kaže.',run(){r2LazaAnswer('iskreno','Znao sam. Radio mi šušti već tri noći, svaki put istim ritmom.','Priznao si Lazi da tražiš signal. On kaže da mu radio šušti tri noći istim ritmom.')}},
    {label:'Ništa, samo sam šetao.',detail:'Prećuti. Laza ostaje oprezan.',run(){r2LazaAnswer('prećuti','Šetao... Dobro. Ali nemoj posle noći tamo, psi su nemirni.','Prećutao si Lazi zašto si išao do stanice. Upozorio te je na pse posle mraka.')}},
    {label:'A zašto ti radio radi celu noć?',detail:'Okreni pitanje. Laza se povlači, ali odaje trag.',run(){r2LazaAnswer('radio','Nije moj da ga gasim. Počne sam, kad se začuje onaj zvuk iz pravca stanice.','Pitao si Lazu za radio. Rekao je da se sam uključuje kad se čuje zvuk iz pravca stanice.')}}])}


/* KALAČ BRDO · FAZA 10 · „Živo naselje“ — autonomni NPC-jevi u Beta 3D.
   Pravi parkić je PARK.poly u Njegoševoj (postojeći podaci igre), bez novih lokacija.
   Imena su izmišljeni likovi. Izabrane kuće nisu tvrdnja o nečijem stanovanju.
   Bez servera, naloga, otvorenog četa ili API ključeva. */
const R2NPC={list:null,parkPoints:[],nextTip:0,nextAmbient:0,acc:0,nearest:null,noticeShown:false,saved:null};
const R2NPC_SAVE='kb_npc_v10';
function r2NpcRand(s,k){return r2Hash(String(s),k)}
function r2NpcHour(){return story.on?23:dayMode===1?12:dayMode===2?18:dayMode===3?23:dayTime}
function r2NpcValid(x,z,r=.32,park=false){return Number.isFinite(x)&&Number.isFinite(z)&&Math.abs(x)<HALF-3&&Math.abs(z)<HALF-3&&(!park||pointInside(x,z,PARK.poly))&&!collide(x,z,r)}
function r2NpcSafe(x,z,r=.32,park=false){
  if(r2NpcValid(x,z,r,park))return {x,z};
  const c=park?PARK_POS:{x,z};
  for(let q=0;q<80;q++){const a=q*2.399963,dist=park?1.4+Math.sqrt(q/80)*17:.6+q*.14;const px=c.x+Math.cos(a)*dist,pz=c.z+Math.sin(a)*dist;if(r2NpcValid(px,pz,r,park))return {x:px,z:pz}}
  return park?{x:PARK_POS.x,z:PARK_POS.z}:{x,z};
}
function r2NpcParkPoint(i){
  const seed=i*97+11;const xs=PARK.poly.map(p=>p[0]),zs=PARK.poly.map(p=>p[1]);const x0=Math.min(...xs),x1=Math.max(...xs),z0=Math.min(...zs),z1=Math.max(...zs);
  for(let t=0;t<110;t++){
    const x=x0+(x1-x0)*r2NpcRand('p'+seed,t*2+1),z=z0+(z1-z0)*r2NpcRand('p'+seed,t*2+2);
    if(r2NpcValid(x,z,.36,true)&&Math.hypot(x-PARK_POS.x,z-PARK_POS.z)<30)return {x,z};
  }
  return r2NpcSafe(PARK_POS.x,PARK_POS.z,.28,true);
}
function r2NpcHouseSpots(){
  /* Ne zavisi od h.door — u prethodnoj fazi većina običnih zgrada uopšte nije imala vrata. */
  const arr=[];
  for(const h of houses){
    if(!h||!h.poly||h.poly.length<4||h.hero||h.laza||h.church)continue;
    const dx=h.c[0]-PARK_POS.x,dz=h.c[1]-PARK_POS.z,di=Math.hypot(dx,dz),area=r2Area(h.poly);
    if(di<20||di>240||area<35||area>270)continue;
    const P=h.poly;
    let edge=null,score=Infinity;
    for(let i=0;i<P.length-1;i++){
      const a=P[i],b=P[i+1],len=Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1]);if(len<2.8)continue;
      const x=(a[0]+b[0])/2,z=(a[1]+b[1])/2,road=nearestRoad(x,z),d=road.d||0;
      if(d<score){score=d;edge={x,z}}
    }
    if(!edge)continue;
    const vx=edge.x-h.c[0],vz=edge.z-h.c[1],l=Math.hypot(vx,vz)||1;
    let spot=null;
    for(const k of [1.5,2.2,3.2,4.4,5.7]){const x=edge.x+vx/l*k,z=edge.z+vz/l*k;
      if(!pointInside(x,z,h.poly)&&r2NpcValid(x,z,.36,false)){spot={x,z};break}}
    if(!spot)continue;
    arr.push({h,spot,score:di+r2NpcRand(String(h.sourceId||di),103)*10});
  }
  arr.sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score);
  const chosen=[];
  for(const item of arr){if(chosen.every(p=>Math.hypot(p.spot.x-item.spot.x,p.spot.z-item.spot.z)>14))chosen.push(item);if(chosen.length>=8)break}
  return chosen;
}
function r2NpcCreate(name,id,group,point,shirt,pants,hair,skin){
  const mem=R2NPC.saved?.[id];
  return {id,name,group,x:point.x,z:point.z,ax:point.x,az:point.z,tx:point.x,tz:point.z,
    shirt,pants,hair,skin,home:point.h||null,seed:r2NpcRand(id,51)*Math.PI*2,
    face:r2NpcRand(id,13)*Math.PI*2,state:'idle',stateEnd:0,stride:0,speed:0,
    visits:Math.max(0,Math.min(2000,Number(mem?.visits)||0)),topic:mem?.topic||'',greeted:false,
    visible:true,nextTalk:0,phase:0,stepIndex:0};
}
function r2NpcEnsure(){
  if(R2NPC.list)return R2NPC.list;
  try{const data=stateStore.get(R2NPC_SAVE,{});R2NPC.saved=data&&typeof data==='object'&&!Array.isArray(data)?data:{}}catch(_){R2NPC.saved={}}
  const homes=r2NpcHouseSpots(),parkPoints=[];
  for(let i=0;i<24;i++)parkPoints.push(r2NpcParkPoint(i));
  R2NPC.parkPoints=parkPoints;
  const arr=[];
  const adults=[
    ['Danica Mladenović','danica_mladenovic','#b880a4','#334b59','#382820','#e4baa0'],
    ['Danica Branković','danica_brankovic','#8c84c5','#3d4d5d','#33251c','#d9ab87'],
    ['Komšinica Milica','komsinica_milica','#72ae99','#3f5660','#654734','#dfb69a'],
    ['Komšija Bora','komsija_bora','#7996aa','#42433d','#4c4038','#bc906f'],
    ['Komšinica Jelena','komsinica_jelena','#d2aa68','#46525a','#483326','#dfb294'],
    ['Komšija Vasa','komsija_vasa','#84966c','#4e4c46','#51483e','#cd9a7b']
  ];
  adults.forEach((a,i)=>{
    // Ako nema odgovarajućih zgrada, odredi bezbednu poziciju pored postojećeg puta, NE izmišljenu kuću.
    const nearest=homes[i]||null;
    let point=nearest?{...nearest.spot,h:nearest.h}:r2NpcParkPoint(i+15);
    if(!r2NpcValid(point.x,point.z,.36))point=r2NpcSafe(point.x,point.z,.36,false);
    const n=r2NpcCreate(a[0],a[1],'adult',point,a[2],a[3],a[4],a[5]);
    n.patrol=[point];for(let j=0;j<4;j++){
      const ang=n.seed+j*Math.PI/2,d=1.2+2.4*r2NpcRand(n.id,j+23),x=n.ax+Math.cos(ang)*d,z=n.az+Math.sin(ang)*d;
      if(r2NpcValid(x,z,.32))n.patrol.push({x,z});
    }
    arr.push(n);
  });
  const kids=[
    ['Mila','mila','#ed8fa7','#4c65a5','#704632','#e4b99b'],
    ['Sara','sara','#efb970','#52787c','#513524','#e1b095'],
    ['Anja','anja','#b78bcf','#576a92','#433020','#d8a78c'],
    ['Nikola','nikola','#76adbc','#34516b','#3c2a24','#ca9676'],
    ['Teodora','teodora','#ef887a','#4b5d89','#65452e','#ddaf92'],
    ['Vuk','vuk','#8cae6d','#41564b','#3e3025','#c99c7d'],
    ['Lena','lena','#b0a1e3','#385d77','#543c2c','#d7a98b'],
    ['Pavle','pavle','#78a8c4','#53633b','#433a32','#d6a88a']
  ];
  kids.forEach((a,i)=>{
    const n=r2NpcCreate(a[0],a[1],'child',parkPoints[(i*3)%parkPoints.length],a[2],a[3],a[4],a[5]);
    n.patrol=parkPoints.filter((p,j)=>j%3===i%3).slice(0,8);if(!n.patrol.length)n.patrol=[{x:n.ax,z:n.az}];n.game=i%3===0?'žmurke':i%3===1?'jurke':'lopta';arr.push(n);
  });

function r2NpcMood(n){const hour=r2NpcHour();if(n.group==='child'&&hour>=21||n.group==='child'&&hour<7.5)return 'home';
  if(n.group==='adult'&&(hour<7||hour>=22))return 'porch';
  if(n.group==='child'&&rain>.6)return 'shelter';
  return n.group==='child'?'play':'walk';
}
function r2NpcChoose(n){
  const mood=r2NpcMood(n),roll=r2NpcRand(n.id+'-'+Math.floor(time/9)+'-'+n.stepIndex++,17);n.mood=mood;
  if(mood==='home'){n.visible=false;n.state='home';n.stateEnd=time+5;return}
  n.visible=true;
  if(mood==='porch'||mood==='shelter'||roll<.23){n.state='idle';n.tx=n.ax;n.tz=n.az;n.stateEnd=time+3+roll*8;return}
  const points=n.patrol||[{x:n.ax,z:n.az}],p=points[Math.floor(roll*points.length)%points.length];
  n.tx=p.x;n.tz=p.z;n.state=n.group==='child'?'play':'walk';n.stateEnd=time+9+roll*6;
}
function r2NpcTick(dt){
  if(!live||paused||transition||interior||football)return;
  R2NPC.acc+=dt;if(R2NPC.acc<.09)return;
  const step=Math.min(.22,R2NPC.acc);R2NPC.acc=0;
  const list=r2NpcEnsure(),p=actors[active];if(!p)return;
  const budget=story.on||window.KBStoryExtensions?.active?2:[3,4,5,6][Math.min(3,quality)]||4;
  const nearby=list.filter(n=>n.visible&&Math.hypot(n.x-p.x,n.z-p.z)<65).sort((a,b)=>(distance(a,p)-(a.paceHidden===false?2:0))-(distance(b,p)-(b.paceHidden===false?2:0))).slice(0,budget);
  const shown=new Set(nearby);for(const n of list)n.paceHidden=!shown.has(n);
  for(const n of list){
    // Jeftin LOD simulacije: daleki NPC ne računaju kolizije, ali im se raspored obnavlja.
    const ds=Math.hypot(n.x-p.x,n.z-p.z);
    if(ds>200&&n.group==='adult'){if(time>n.stateEnd)r2NpcChoose(n);continue}
    if(n.mood!==r2NpcMood(n)){r2NpcChoose(n)}
    if(n.state==='talk'&&time<n.stateEnd){n.face=Math.atan2(p.x-n.x,p.z-n.z);n.speed=0;continue}
    if(time>n.stateEnd||!n.stateEnd)r2NpcChoose(n);
    if(!n.visible)continue;
    const dx=n.tx-n.x,dz=n.tz-n.z,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
    if(dist>.24&&n.state!=='idle'){
      const speed=n.group==='child'?(n.game==='jurke'?2.0:1.35):.72;
      const travel=Math.min(dist,speed*step),nx=n.x+dx/dist*travel,nz=n.z+dz/dist*travel;
      if(r2NpcValid(nx,nz,n.group==='child'?.28:.36,n.group==='child')){
        n.x=nx;n.z=nz;n.face=Math.atan2(dx,dz);n.speed=travel/step;n.stride+=travel*3.1;
      }else {n.tx=n.x;n.tz=n.z;n.state='idle';n.stateEnd=time+2.4;n.speed=0}
    }else {n.speed=0;n.stride+=step*.5;if(dist<.4&&n.state!=='idle')n.stateEnd=Math.min(n.stateEnd,time+.4)}
  }
  if(time>R2NPC.nextTip&&!story.on&&!window.KBStoryExtensions?.active&&!journalOpen&&!mapOpen){const n=r2NpcNearest(4.2);if(n){R2NPC.nextTip=time+14;tip('E / RADNJA · Razgovaraj sa '+n.name,3)}}
  // Diskretni, ambijentalni razgovori: nisu online čet i ne prekidaju priču / aktivni dijalog.
  if(time>R2NPC.nextAmbient&&!story.on&&!window.KBStoryExtensions?.active&&!mapOpen&&!journalOpen&&time>subtitleUntil+2&&!(cine&&cine.choice)&&!(dialogueQueue&&dialogueQueue.length)){
    const nearby=list.filter(n=>n.visible&&Math.hypot(n.x-p.x,n.z-p.z)<15).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-p.x,a.z-p.z)-Math.hypot(b.x-p.x,b.z-p.z));
    if(nearby.length){const n=nearby[0],msg=n.group==='child'?(n.game==='jurke'?'Trči do drveta, pa nazad do klupe!':n.game==='žmurke'?'Brojim do deset, ne virim!':'Dodaj loptu, ali nežno!'):(rain>.6?'Evo kiše, svi će pod strehe.':'Dobar dan, komšije!');
      say(n.name,msg,3.4);R2NPC.nextAmbient=time+21+r2NpcRand(n.id,Math.floor(time))*8;
    }else R2NPC.nextAmbient=time+9;
  }
}
function r2NpcNearest(maxD=4.6){
  const p=actors[active];if(!p||interior||football)return null;
  let b=null,d=maxD;
  for(const n of r2NpcEnsure())if(n.visible&&!n.paceHidden){const m=Math.hypot(n.x-p.x,n.z-p.z);if(m<d){d=m;b=n}}
  return b;
}
function r2NpcPrompt(){if(story.on&&task()&&distance(actors[active],task())<7)return '';
  const n=r2NpcNearest(4.6);return n?'RAZGOVOR · E · '+n.name:''}
function r2NpcContext(n){
  if(story.on)return 'Čujem da vas trojica nešto istražujete. Pazite kuda idete i držite se zajedno.';
  if(rain>.55)return 'Baš se nebo namračilo. Kad prođe kiša, biće više ljudi napolju.';
  if(r2NpcHour()>19)return 'Uveče ovde svako prepozna svetla iz svog kraja.';
  if(season===3)return 'Zimi je drugačije, ali Njegoševa i parkić su isti.';
  return 'Danas je ceo kraj živ. Neko šeta, neko razgovara, a deca se igraju u parku.';
}
function r2NpcGreeting(n){
  const first=n.visits===0;
  const base={
    danica_mladenovic:first?'Ćao, Andrej! Ja sam Danica. Lepo što si svratio do Njegoševe.':'E, Andrej! Opet obilaziš kraj?',
    danica_brankovic:first?'Zdravo! Ja sam Danica. Baš sam izašla na vazduh, ima li šta novo?':'Evo te ponovo! Kako ide istraživanje?',
    komsinica_milica:'Dobro došao! Danas ima baš dosta dešavanja po kraju.',
    komsija_bora:'Kako si, momče? Stigao si taman na vreme za šetnju.',
    komsinica_jelena:'Dobar dan! Svrati nekad do parkića, tamo je društvo.',
    komsija_vasa:'Zdravo! Ima li šta novo u kraju?'
  };
  if(n.group==='child')return first?'Ćao! Ja sam '+n.name+'. Igramo se ovde u parkiću u Njegoševoj.':'Opet si tu! Još smo u igri.';
  return base[n.id]||'Zdravo, svraćaš u pravo vreme!';
}
function r2NpcTopic(n,topic){
  const child=n.group==='child';
  if(topic==='park')return child?('Igramo '+(n.game||'jurke')+' u parkiću i pazimo da ne izađemo na ulicu.'):
    'Parkić u Njegoševoj ima klupe, drveće i ukrštene staze. Tu se često sreću komšije.';
  if(topic==='people')return child?'Društvo mi je tu. Danas se smenjujemo ko vodi igru.':
    'Kad nekoga pozdraviš, uvek ćeš saznati nešto novo o kraju. '+r2NpcContext(n);
  if(topic==='help')return child?'Ako tražiš Reksa, pogledaj blizu klupe. Nekad svrati da vidi šta radimo.':
    'Za dobru šetnju prati osvetljene ulice. A ako tražiš Peru, raspitaj se kod drugara.';
  return 'Vidimo se uskoro!';
}
function r2NpcRemember(n,topic){
  n.topic=topic;const next={...(R2NPC.saved||{})};next[n.id]={visits:n.visits,topic};R2NPC.saved=next;
  try{stateStore.put(R2NPC_SAVE,next)}catch(_){}
}
function r2NpcInteract(){
  if(!live||paused||transition||interior||football)return false;
  if(story.on&&task()&&distance(actors[active],task())<7)return false;
  const n=r2NpcNearest(4.9);if(!n)return false;
  if(n.nextTalk>time){tip(n.name+' upravo završava rečenicu.',2);return true}
  n.state='talk';n.stateEnd=time+5;n.nextTalk=time+1.1;R2NPC.nextAmbient=time+25;n.face=Math.atan2(actors[active].x-n.x,actors[active].z-n.z);
  const first=n.visits===0;n.visits++;r2NpcRemember(n,'greeting');
  conversation([[n.name,r2NpcGreeting({...n,visits:first?0:n.visits}),4.2]]);
  if(first)archive('npc10_'+n.id,'Upoznali smo: '+n.name,
    (n.group==='child'?'Susret u postojećem parkiću u Njegoševoj.':'Susret u kraju, ispred izmišljene NPC lokacije.')+' Lik je izmišljen za igru.');
  // Izbori su bezbedni i lokalni: ništa se ne šalje na server i ne traži se lični podatak.
  const opts=n.group==='child'?
    [['Šta igrate?','Pitaj za igru u parku.','park'],['Kako je društvo?','Kratak razgovor o ekipi.','people'],['Vidimo se!','Završi razgovor.','bye']]:
    [['Šta ima u kraju?','Vesti i vreme u okolini.','people'],['Pričaj mi o parkiću','Ko se okuplja u Njegoševoj?','park'],['Imaš li savet?','Kratak savet za šetnju.','help']];
  if(!cine)cine=newCine();
  offerDecision(n.name+' · O čemu želiš da pričaš?',opts.map(([label,detail,topic])=>({label,detail,run(){
    r2NpcRemember(n,topic);n.state='talk';n.stateEnd=time+3.5;
    conversation([[n.name,r2NpcTopic(n,topic),4.5]]);
  }})));
  return true;
}
function drawR2NPCs(m){
  if(interior||football)return;

  for(const n of r2NpcEnsure()){

    const child=n.group==='child',scale=child?.78:1,Y=height(n.x,n.z),phase=n.stride,bob=(n.speed>.2?Math.abs(Math.sin(phase))*.037:Math.sin(time*1.4+n.seed)*.011)*scale;
    const close=d<([15,22,30,40,55][quality]||22),sc=scale;
    const body=Mesh(),leg= Math.sin(phase)*Math.min(.19,n.speed*.055),arm=-leg*.75;
    // Svi delovi su u lokalnim koordinatama: trup, glava, šake, odeća i obuća.

    body.sphere(0,1.44*sc,0,.073*sc,.10*sc,.072*sc,n.skin);

    body.sphere(0,1.775*sc,-.012*sc,.173*sc,.116*sc,.158*sc,n.hair);

      roundBone(body,[off,.8*sc,0],knee,.094*sc,n.pants,.067*sc,0,6);roundBone(body,knee,ankle,.074*sc,n.pants,.052*sc,0,6);
      body.sphere(off,.084*sc,.066*sc+foot,.081*sc,.067*sc,.143*sc,'#323735');
      const elbow=[side*.275*sc,1.10*sc,arm*side+.027],hand=[side*.28*sc,(talk?1.28:.90)*sc,talk?.29:arm*side*1.55+.038];
      roundBone(body,[side*.219*sc,1.32*sc,0],elbow,.084*sc,n.shirt,.067*sc,0,6);roundBone(body,elbow,hand,.063*sc,n.shirt,.047*sc,0,6);
      body.sphere(...hand,.047*sc,.067*sc,.045*sc,n.skin);
      if(close){body.sphere(side*.155*sc,1.65*sc,0,.032*sc,.052*sc,.026*sc,n.skin);body.sphere(side*.06*sc,1.687*sc,.145*sc,.018*sc,.013*sc,.012*sc,'#493a31');}
    }
    // Sve funkcioniše i na starom WebGL1, bez spoljnog modela / teksture.
    transformMesh(m,body.out,n.x,Y+bob,n.z,n.face,0,0,1);
    if(n.group==='child'&&n.state==='play'&&close&&n.game==='lopta')m.sphere(n.x+.38,Y+.15,n.z+.2,.13,.13,.13,'#e8d7ae');
  }
}

function kb11Torso(m,low,high,waist,shoulder,depthLow,depthHi,color){
  const sides=10,ring=(y,rx,rz,k)=>[Math.cos(k*TAU/sides)*rx,y,Math.sin(k*TAU/sides)*rz];
  for(let k=0;k<sides;k++){

    m.quad(a,b,c,d,color,3);
  }

}
function kb11Line(m,a,b,r,col){roundBone(m,a,b,r,col,r*.9,0,5)}
function kb11Flower(m,x,y,z,s){

function gripWorld(local,a,Y,lean,tilt,scale){

   zz=-yy*Math.sin(tilt)+z*Math.cos(tilt),co=Math.cos(a.yaw||0),si=Math.sin(a.yaw||0);

}
function flashlightRig(m,p,first){

 const ang=yaw-turn*.038+moving*.009*Math.sin(p.phase),elev=pitch-.025+moving*.011*Math.cos(p.phase*2);
 const dir=[Math.sin(ang)*Math.cos(elev),Math.sin(elev),Math.cos(ang)*Math.cos(elev)],right=[Math.cos(yaw),0,-Math.sin(yaw)],
 up=[-Math.sin(yaw)*Math.sin(pitch),Math.cos(pitch),-Math.cos(yaw)*Math.sin(pitch)];
 const L=lampLevel();if(L<.02)return;
 const start=first?cam.eye.map((v,i)=>v+dir[i]*.31+right[i]*.205-up[i]*(.19+(1-L)*.62)+right[i]*(1-L)*.12):motion.hand;

    stamp(-22,-182,8);stamp(22,-172,8);stamp(-16,-147,10);stamp(18,-125,6);

  }else if(index===1){

  }else{

 for(const f of r6.fences){if(hyp(f.a[0]-v.x,f.a[1]-v.z)>radius)continue;const a=planProject(...f.a),b=planProject(...f.b),A=planProject(...f.a,1.5),B=planProject(...f.b,1.5);c.fillStyle='#8a7557';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...a);c.lineTo(...b);c.lineTo(...B);c.lineTo(...A);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#c0a170';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...A);c.lineTo(...B);c.stroke();}

 c.strokeStyle='#c2d5b880';c.lineWidth=1;for(const path of PARK.paths){c.beginPath();path.forEach((a,i)=>i?c.lineTo(...planProject(...a)):c.moveTo(...planProject(...a)));c.stroke();}

 const target=story.on?task():waypoint;if(target){const a=planProject(target.x,target.z);c.strokeStyle='#ffe3ac';c.lineWidth=1.7;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(...a,s*.8,s*.5,0,0,TAU);c.stroke();}

}
function drawPlanLight(c){if(football)return;const p=actors[active],v=r6.view,mask=r6.maskCtx,W=v.W,H=v.H;if(r6.mask.width!==r6.canvas.width||r6.mask.height!==r6.canvas.height){r6.mask.width=r6.canvas.width;r6.mask.height=r6.canvas.height;}mask.setTransform(v.dpr,0,0,v.dpr,0,0);mask.clearRect(0,0,W,H);mask.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';mask.fillStyle='rgba(3,12,21,'+(dusk*.78)+')';mask.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const A=planProject(p.x,p.z);if(lampEffective()){mask.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';const precise=!document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')&&r6.avg<16,key=r6.field.serial+':'+Math.round(yaw*400)+':'+active+':'+precise;if(r6.fanKey!==key){r6.fanKey=key;r6.coneFan=r6.field.polygon(Math.PI/2-yaw,active===0?.34:active===2?.60:.44,precise);}const fan=r6.coneFan;mask.save();KBLight2D.path(mask,fan,q=>planProject(q.x,q.y));mask.clip();const grad=mask.createRadialGradient(...A,0,...A,48*v.s);grad.addColorStop(0,'#fffffffa');grad.addColorStop(.42,'#ffffffb0');grad.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.fillStyle=grad;mask.fillRect(0,0,W,H);mask.restore();if(r6.fullFanSerial!==r6.field.serial){r6.fullFanSerial=r6.field.serial;r6.fullFan=r6.field.polygon(0,Math.PI,false);}const ambient=r6.fullFan;mask.save();KBLight2D.path(mask,ambient,q=>planProject(q.x,q.y));mask.clip();const g=mask.createRadialGradient(...A,0,...A,4*v.s);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffffb0');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.fillStyle=g;mask.fillRect(A[0]-4*v.s,A[1]-4*v.s,8*v.s,8*v.s);mask.restore();}
 if(dusk>.4){mask.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';for(const pole of poles){if(distance(p,pole)>65)continue;const q=planProject(pole.x,pole.z),g=mask.createRadialGradient(...q,0,...q,8*v.s);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff60');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.fillStyle=g;mask.beginPath();mask.ellipse(q[0],q[1],8*v.s,6.24*v.s,0,0,TAU);mask.fill();}}if(cine)for(const f of cine.flares.filter(f=>f.until>time).slice(-3)){const a=planProject(f.x,f.z),g=mask.createRadialGradient(...a,0,...a,13*v.s);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffffda');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');mask.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';mask.fillStyle=g;mask.beginPath();mask.arc(...a,13*v.s,0,TAU);mask.fill();}mask.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';c.drawImage(r6.mask,0,0,W,H);}
function renderAtmosphere(c,W,H,s=1){const eco=document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco'),p=actors[active],near=dogs.reduce((n,d)=>Math.min(n,distance(p,d)),cine?.shadow?distance(p,cine.shadow):1e5),danger=clamp(1-near/15,0,1),pulse=reduced?.65:.65+.35*Math.sin(time*6);c.save();if(r6.fog){c.globalCompositeOperation='screen';for(let layer=0;layer<(eco?2:4);layer++){const w=W*(.75+layer*.17),h=H*(.30+layer*.04),x=((time*(5+layer*3)-p.x*(layer+1)*.7)%(w+W)+w+W)%(w+W)-w,y=H*(.40+layer*.14)+Math.sin(time*.13+layer)*H*.04;c.globalAlpha=(.12+dusk*.18+rain*.15)/(1+layer*.15);c.drawImage(r6.fog,x,y,w,h);c.drawImage(r6.fog,x+w,y,w,h);}c.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';c.globalAlpha=1;}
 if(rain>.12||season===2){const n=eco?26:r6.avg>16?45:86;c.strokeStyle='#b8d0df70';c.lineWidth=.8;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=r6.particles[i],x=((a.x*W-time*(season===2?15:50)*a.s)%W+W)%W,y=((a.y*H+time*(season===2?27:320)*a.s)%H+H)%H;if(season===2){c.fillStyle=i%2?'#c1a25b99':'#ac7d4b99';c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(time+a.phase);c.fillRect(-3,-1.4,6,2.8);c.restore();}else{c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(x-4,y+12*a.s);c.stroke();}}}
 const vin=c.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H*.5,H*.17,W*.5,H*.5,H*.80);vin.addColorStop(0,'#00000000');vin.addColorStop(1,'rgba('+(danger>0?'58,10,19':'2,9,16')+','+(.35+danger*pulse*.4)+')');c.fillStyle=vin;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 {const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(20,60,84,'+(.12+dusk*.16)+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,140,64,'+(.09*(1-dusk))+')');c.globalCompositeOperation='soft-light';c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 if(!eco){const pt=kbGrain(c),rx=Math.random()*128|0,ry=Math.random()*128|0;c.save();c.translate(rx,ry);c.globalCompositeOperation='overlay';c.globalAlpha=.07+dusk*.04;c.fillStyle=pt;c.fillRect(-rx,-ry,W,H);c.restore()}
 c.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';c.globalAlpha=1}
 c.restore();scene.dataset.threat=String(Math.round(danger*100));}
function renderPlan(dt,ts){initPlan();if(r6.post)r6.post.style.display='none';r6.canvas.style.display='block';const start=performance.now(),W=scene.clientWidth,H=scene.clientHeight,eco=document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco'),dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,eco?1:1.5)*r6.scale;if(r6.canvas.width!==Math.round(W*dpr)||r6.canvas.height!==Math.round(H*dpr)){r6.canvas.width=Math.round(W*dpr);r6.canvas.height=Math.round(H*dpr);}const p=football?football.players[football.selected]:actors[active],flight=transition?Math.sin(clamp(transition.t/transition.duration,0,1)*Math.PI):0,s=clamp(Math.min(W/88,H/51),6.5,18)*(1-flight*.65);r6.view={x:transition?cam.eye[0]:p.x,z:transition?cam.eye[2]:p.z,s,W,H,dpr};const c=r6.ctx;c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);c.fillStyle='#3b5847';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);updateRayLight();drawPlanWorld(c,p);window.KBStoryExtensions?.paintPlan(c,s);drawPlanLight(c);renderAtmosphere(c,W,H,s);r6.cost=performance.now()-start;r6.avg=lerp(r6.avg,r6.cost,.04);r6.frames++;if(ts-r6.since>1000){r6.fps=Math.round(r6.frames*1000/(ts-r6.since));r6.frames=0;r6.since=ts;}scene.dataset.renderer='canvas-2.5d';scene.dataset.fps=String(r6.fps);scene.dataset.frameMs=r6.avg.toFixed(2);scene.dataset.rays=String(r6.field.samples);}
function changeCamera(){if(directorShot||football)return;view=(view+1)%3;if(view===2&&document.pointerLockElement===scene)document.exitPointerLock();if(software&&view!==2&&!staticCount)renderWorld(true);if(r6.canvas)r6.canvas.style.display=view===2?'block':'none';snapCamera();updateHUD();}
/* Drugari pričaju usput: kratke replike po situaciji (dan, noć, kiša, psi) + filmsko zrno */
const KB_BANTER={
Andrej:{day:["Ajde, bre, ne zadržavaj se.","Ovo je moj teren, znam svaku rupu.","Lazare, manje razmišljaj, više hodaj.","Ako zaglavimo, ja vodim, vi pratite.","Ma super dan, samo fali neka avantura."],
night:["Mrak je, ali ja sam miran. Skoro.","Držimo se zajedno, niko ne luta sam.","Čuješ li to? Ma ništa, vetar.","Baterija je kod nas, bez panike.","Noću ovaj kraj izgleda sasvim drugačije."],
rain:["Kiša, naravno. Baš sad.","Mokar sam do kostiju, ali idemo.","Blato će nam pojesti patike.","Bar je manje sveta napolju.","Ne stajte pod drvetom, hajde dalje."],
dog:["Polako, ne trči, psi to osete.","Ne gledaj ga u oči, samo hodaj.","Stani iza mene, ja ću ga skrenuti.","Čujem ga, blizu je.","Ako laje, ne beži. Beži tek ako krene."]},
Lazar:{day:["Po mojoj proceni, prečica nam štedi pet minuta.","Signal je slab ovde, zapamti to mesto.","Hajde da ne žurimo, mapa je jasna.","Ovaj put je bolji nego što izgleda.","Telefon mi je na trideset posto, štedim."],
night:["Vidljivost je loša, hodajmo polako.","Upali baterijsku pre nego što nešto zgazimo.","Čujem korake, ili mi se čini.","Noću se zvuk čudno širi po ovom brdu.","Ne volim ovaj deo kad padne mrak."],
rain:["Kiša kvari signal, tako to ide.","Pazite na blato, klizavo je.","Telefon mora da ostane suv.","Staza je klizava, usporite.","Do kraja ulice pa pod nadstrešnicu."],
dog:["Samo bez naglih pokreta, molim vas.","Ja ću iza vas, ako nemate ništa protiv.","Pas. Ne, ne ide mi se tamo.","Ostanite mirni, hodajte unazad.","Znao sam da ćemo ga sresti."]},
Petar:{day:["Kad završimo, idemo na burek, ja častim. Možda.","Bre, gladan sam, a tek smo krenuli.","Znaš šta bi sad prijalo? Pljeskavica.","Ovo je kao bioskop, samo bez kokica.","Bee, kad ćemo već nešto da pojedemo?"],
night:["Bee, ovo je baš mračno.","Ko je ono? Šalim se, šalim se.","Samo da nema nekog iz mraka, jel da?","Imam u torbi grickalice za hrabrost.","Pevaću tiho da ne bude neprijatno."],
rain:["Mokra mi je jakna, a nije jeftina.","Ko je poručio kišu? Priznajte.","Bar se sve opralo, i mi.","Ajde brže, hoću na suvo i da jedem.","Bre, kiša kao da je naručena."],
dog:["Bee, pas! Niko se ne pomera!","Dajem mu sendvič, samo da me ne juri.","Ja sam alergičan na trčanje.","Andrej, ti si hrabar, idi ti prvi.","Ako me ujede, vi zovite hitnu i mamu."]}};
let kbBanterNext=0,kbBanterLast='';
setInterval(()=>{try{
 if(!live||paused||transition||worldMini||story.on||football||interior||time<msgTime)return;
 if(!kbBanterNext){kbBanterNext=time+25;return}
 if(time<kbBanterNext)return;
 const p=actors[active],nm=(CREW_ROLES[active]||{}).name||'Andrej',pool=KB_BANTER[nm]||KB_BANTER.Andrej;
 const ctx=dogs.some(d=>distance(p,d)<16)?'dog':rain>.3?'rain':dusk>.55?'night':'day',arr=pool[ctx];
 let l;do{l=arr[Math.random()*arr.length|0]}while(l===kbBanterLast&&arr.length>1);
 kbBanterLast=l;tip(nm+': '+l,4.5);kbBanterNext=time+(ctx==='dog'?14:28+Math.random()*22);
}catch(e){}},1000);
let kbGrainPat=null;
function kbGrain(c){if(!kbGrainPat){const n=document.createElement('canvas');n.width=n.height=128;const x=n.getContext('2d'),d=x.createImageData(128,128);for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){d.data[i]=d.data[i+1]=d.data[i+2]=90+Math.random()*130|0;d.data[i+3]=255}x.putImageData(d,0,0);kbGrainPat=c.createPattern(n,'repeat')}return kbGrainPat}
function renderPostFX(){initPlan();if(!r6.post){const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.id='kbAtmosphere6';cv.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1';hud.prepend(cv);r6.post=cv;r6.postCtx=cv.getContext('2d');}r6.post.style.display='block';const W=scene.clientWidth,H=scene.clientHeight,dpr=.65;if(r6.post.width!==Math.round(W*dpr)||r6.post.height!==Math.round(H*dpr)){r6.post.width=Math.round(W*dpr);r6.post.height=Math.round(H*dpr);}const c=r6.postCtx;c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);c.clearRect(0,0,W,H);renderAtmosphere(c,W,H);}
function updateR6HUD(){if($('r6Performance'))$('r6Performance').textContent='MERENJE: '+(view===2?r6.fps:fps)+' FPS · '+r6.avg.toFixed(1)+' ms · '+(document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')?'ECO':'AUTO');if($('r6Eco'))$('r6Eco').textContent='ŠTEDNJA GRAFIKE: '+(document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')?'DA':'NE');}
function drawPlanPitch(c){const F=football?.field||FIELD;if(distance(actors[active],FIELD)>120&&!football)return;const corners=[[F.x-F.w/2,F.z-F.d/2],[F.x+F.w/2,F.z-F.d/2],[F.x+F.w/2,F.z+F.d/2],[F.x-F.w/2,F.z+F.d/2]];pathWorld(c,[corners]);c.fillStyle='#356a4d';c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#d8ddbd';c.lineWidth=1.4;c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...planProject(F.x,F.z-F.d/2));c.lineTo(...planProject(F.x,F.z+F.d/2));c.stroke();for(const sign of [-1,1]){const a=planProject(F.x+sign*F.w/2,F.z-3.5),b=planProject(F.x+sign*F.w/2,F.z+3.5);c.strokeStyle='#e5e7d3';c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...a);c.lineTo(...b);c.stroke();}}

function drawPlanSolid(c,a){const b=a.bound,s=r6.view.s;if(a.r){const q=planProject(a.x,a.z);c.strokeStyle='#98a79b';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,a.r*s);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...q);c.lineTo(q[0],q[1]-s*(a.kind==='floodlight'?5.5:1.7));c.stroke();return;}const offset=a.kind==='station'?1.7:a.kind==='bench'?.40:a.kind==='ruin'?1.2:a.kind==='logs'?.6:.8,col=a.kind==='station'?'#a4b9b6':a.kind==='ruin'?'#9c7362':a.kind==='bench'?'#a3885d':'#7c7759';for(const r of a.rings||[]){for(let i=1;i<r.length;i++){const A=planProject(...r[i-1]),B=planProject(...r[i]),C=planProject(...r[i],offset),D=planProject(...r[i-1],offset);c.fillStyle=a.kind==='station'?'#647e82':'#5c6254';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...A);c.lineTo(...B);c.lineTo(...C);c.lineTo(...D);c.fill();}pathWorld(c,[r],offset);c.fillStyle=col;c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#263e3f';c.lineWidth=1;c.stroke();}if(a.kind==='station'){const x=(b[0]+b[2])/2,z=(b[1]+b[3])/2,q=planProject(x+2,z,1.7),t=planProject(x+2,z,5.8);c.strokeStyle='#c1d0ca';c.lineWidth=1.4;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...q);c.lineTo(...t);c.moveTo(t[0]-s*.8,t[1]+s*.5);c.lineTo(t[0]+s*.8,t[1]+s*.5);c.moveTo(t[0]-s*.5,t[1]+s*.9);c.lineTo(t[0]+s*.5,t[1]+s*.9);c.stroke();}if(a.kind==='bench'){for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const z=b[1]+(i+.5)*(b[3]-b[1])/3;c.strokeStyle='#d1b27b88';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...planProject(b[0],z,.43));c.lineTo(...planProject(b[2],z,.43));c.stroke();}}}
function drawPlanStory(c,p){const s=r6.view.s;if(part2)part2.paintPlanCovers(c,s);if(cine){for(const f of cine.flares.filter(f=>f.until>time)){const q=planProject(f.x,f.z),g=c.createRadialGradient(...q,0,...q,s*1.9);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffe7a9bb');g.addColorStop(1,'#eaaa5500');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(q[0]-s*2,q[1]-s*2,s*4,s*4);c.fillStyle='#ffe7a0';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[0],q[1]-s*.4,s*.11,s*.5,0,0,TAU);c.fill();}if(cine.shadow){const sh=cine.shadow,q=planProject(sh.x,sh.z);c.fillStyle='#07121cec';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[0],q[1]-s*.9,s*.4,s*1.3,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#efa38a';for(const sign of [-1,1])c.fillRect(q[0]+sign*s*.12-s*.03,q[1]-s*1.6,s*.07,s*.055);}}
 if(story.on&&missionScene){if(story.chapter===0){const a=missionScene.phone,q=planProject(a.x,a.z);c.fillStyle='#132a31';c.fillRect(q[0]-s*.12,q[1]-s*.23,s*.24,s*.46);c.fillStyle='#9ce8d8';c.fillRect(q[0]-s*.09,q[1]-s*.17,s*.18,s*.31);const b=missionScene.bench,B=[b.x-.9,b.z-.25,b.x+.9,b.z+.25];drawPlanSolid(c,{kind:'bench',bound:B,rings:[boxPoly(b.x,b.z,1.8,.5)]});}if(story.chapter===1){const g=missionScene.gate,a=planProject(g.x-1.8,g.z),b=planProject(g.x+1.8,cine.flags.gateOpen?g.z-3:g.z);c.strokeStyle='#bb9d70';c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...a);c.lineTo(...b);c.stroke();}if(story.chapter===2){const cond=stationConditions();for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const a=missionScene.pads[i],q=planProject(a.x,a.z);c.strokeStyle=cond[i]?'#a9e6ba':CREW_ROLES[i].accent;c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(...q,s*(i===0?6:2.5),s*(i===0?4.68:1.95),0,0,TAU);c.stroke();c.fillStyle=cond[i]?'#9be2ba':'#9cab9d';c.fillRect(q[0]+s*.55,q[1]-s*.8,s*.4,s*.55);}}}
 if(worldEvent?.type==='patrol'&&worldEvent.state!=='approach'){const a=worldEvent.car,q=planProject(a.x,a.z);c.save();c.translate(...q);c.scale(1,.78);c.rotate(-a.yaw);c.fillStyle='#06121a77';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(s*.2,s*.2,s,s*2.4,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#172630';c.beginPath();c.roundRect(-s*.85,-s*2,s*1.7,s*4,s*.25);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#3c5058';c.fillRect(-s*.67,-s*.9,s*1.34,s*.55);c.fillRect(-s*.67,s*.8,s*1.34,s*.4);c.fillStyle='#111e28';c.fillRect(-s*.65,-s*.3,s*1.3,s*.99);c.restore();}
 if(worldEvent?.type==='crash')paintCrashPlan(c,s);
}

/* Kratki izvori dijele šum i prostorne čvorove; nema mrežnih audio fajlova. */
const sound6={noise:null,station:null,filter:null,nextListener:0};
function groundMaterial(x,z){if(pointInside(x,z,PARK.poly))return 'grass';if(distance({x,z},LOC[4])<80)return 'mud';const n=nearestRoad(x,z);if(n.road&&n.d<n.road.width*.65){if(/Njegoševa|Gostivarska/.test(n.road.name))return 'asphalt';if(/path|foot|track|steps/.test(n.road.type)||distance({x,z},LOC[0])<60)return rain>.5?'mud':'gravel';return 'asphalt';}return inWood(x,z)?rain>.3?'mud':'grass':inGreen(x,z)?'grass':'gravel';}
function sourcePan(at,output=audio?.destination){if(!audio)return null;let pan;if(audio.createPanner){pan=audio.createPanner();pan.panningModel='HRTF';pan.distanceModel='inverse';pan.refDistance=3;pan.maxDistance=100;pan.rolloffFactor=.9;const y=height(at.x,at.z)+.8;if(pan.positionX){pan.positionX.value=at.x;pan.positionY.value=y;pan.positionZ.value=at.z;}else pan.setPosition(at.x,y,at.z);}else if(audio.createStereoPanner){pan=audio.createStereoPanner();pan.pan.value=clamp(Math.sin(Math.atan2(at.x-actors[active].x,at.z-actors[active].z)-yaw),-1,1);}else return output;pan.connect(output);return pan;}
function makeNoise(){if(sound6.noise||!audio)return;const n=Math.floor(audio.sampleRate*.5),b=audio.createBuffer(1,n,audio.sampleRate),a=b.getChannelData(0),r=randSeed(1761);let brown=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){brown=(brown+(r()*2-1)*.09)/1.03;a[i]=brown*.6+(r()*2-1)*.2;}sound6.noise=b;}
function surfaceStep(){if(!audio||audio.state!=='running')return;makeNoise();const p=actors[active],kind=groundMaterial(p.x,p.z),profiles={asphalt:[850,.055,.13,115],gravel:[2300,.105,.17,160],grass:[430,.09,.10,75],mud:[210,.14,.15,58]},[freq,length,volume,tone]=profiles[kind],t=audio.currentTime,src=audio.createBufferSource(),filter=audio.createBiquadFilter(),gain=audio.createGain();src.buffer=sound6.noise;src.playbackRate.value=kind==='mud'?.7:kind==='gravel'?1.35:1;filter.type=kind==='gravel'?'highpass':'lowpass';filter.frequency.value=freq;gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume*(p.move>5?1.15:.8),t+.008);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+length);src.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(audio.destination);src.start(t,(p.phase%1)*.15);src.stop(t+length+.02);src.onended=()=>{src.disconnect();filter.disconnect();gain.disconnect();};const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(tone,t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(tone*.45,t+length);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.018,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+length);o.connect(g);g.connect(audio.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+length+.01);o.onended=()=>{o.disconnect();g.disconnect();};scene.dataset.surface=kind;}
function spatialBark(volume=1,at=actors[active]){if(!audio||audio.state!=='running')return;makeNoise();const pan=sourcePan(at),t=audio.currentTime,src=audio.createBufferSource(),filter=audio.createBiquadFilter(),gain=audio.createGain();src.buffer=sound6.noise;src.playbackRate.value=.75;filter.type='bandpass';filter.frequency.value=520;filter.Q.value=1.5;const blocked=!lineClear(actors[active],at,.08),v=volume*(blocked?.045:.12);gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.001,v),t+.018);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+.10);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.002,v*.7),t+.145);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.29);src.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(pan);src.start(t);src.stop(t+.32);src.onended=()=>{src.disconnect();filter.disconnect();gain.disconnect();if(pan!==audio.destination)pan.disconnect();};}
function prepareStationAudio(){if(!audio||sound6.station)return;const pan=sourcePan(LOC[8]),filter=audio.createBiquadFilter();filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=1800;filter.connect(pan);sound6.station=pan;sound6.filter=filter;for(const g of stationAudio||[]){g.disconnect();g.connect(filter);}}
function spatialListener(){if(!audio||time<sound6.nextListener)return;sound6.nextListener=time+.08;const a=actors[active],L=audio.listener,Y=height(a.x,a.z)+1.6,fx=Math.sin(yaw),fz=Math.cos(yaw),t=audio.currentTime;if(L.positionX){L.positionX.setValueAtTime(a.x,t);L.positionY.setValueAtTime(Y,t);L.positionZ.setValueAtTime(a.z,t);L.forwardX.setValueAtTime(fx,t);L.forwardY.setValueAtTime(0,t);L.forwardZ.setValueAtTime(fz,t);L.upX.setValueAtTime(0,t);L.upY.setValueAtTime(1,t);L.upZ.setValueAtTime(0,t);}else{L.setPosition?.(a.x,Y,a.z);L.setOrientation?.(fx,0,fz,0,1,0);}prepareStationAudio();if(sound6.filter){const occluded=!lineClear(a,{x:LOC[8].x,z:LOC[8].z+4},.1);sound6.filter.frequency.setTargetAtTime(occluded?450:1800,audio.currentTime,.2);}}

/* Dva lokalna izazova dijele fokus i životni ciklus glavne igre. */

const quick=document.createElement('div');quick.id='kbQuickGames';quick.hidden=true;quick.innerHTML=`<div class="r6-quick-panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="r6QuickTitle"><header><div><small id="r6QuickRole"></small><h2 id="r6QuickTitle"></h2></div><button type="button" id="r6QuickClose">NASTAVI ×</button></header><div class="r6-quick-stats"><b id="r6QuickScore"></b><span id="r6QuickClock"></span></div><canvas id="r6QuickCanvas" width="800" height="440" aria-label="Prikaz aktivnog izazova"></canvas><div id="r6QuickControls"></div><p id="r6QuickMessage" role="status"></p><div class="r6-quick-footer"><button id="r6QuickFire" type="button">ŠUT · SPACE</button><button id="r6QuickAgain" type="button">NOVA SERIJA</button><span id="r6QuickHint"></span></div></div>`;gm.appendChild(quick);
$('r6QuickClose').onclick=closeWorldMini;$('r6QuickFire').onclick=()=>{if(worldMini?.type==='kick'&&worldMini.core.shoot())sound('kick');};$('r6QuickAgain').onclick=()=>{if(!worldMini)return;worldMini.core=worldMini.type==='kick'?new KBQuickGames.FreeKick():new KBQuickGames.SignalLock();worldMini.awarded=false;syncQuickControls();cancelAnimationFrame(miniRaf);miniLast=performance.now();miniRaf=requestAnimationFrame(quickFrame);};
function quickLocations(){return {kick:{x:FIELD.x-22,z:FIELD.z-18,n:'Slobodni udarac u sumrak'},signal:{x:LOC[8].x,z:LOC[8].z+10,n:'Dekodiranje meteo-signala'}};}
function worldMiniPrompt(){if(story.on||football||interior)return '';const p=actors[active],L=quickLocations();if(distance(p,L.kick)<6)return active===0?'SLOBODNI UDARAC · E':'ANDREJ: SLOBODNI UDARAC · 1';if(distance(p,L.signal)<6)return r6.gateOpen?'ARHIVA METEO STANICE · E':active===1?'DEKODIRAJ KAPIJU · E':'LAZAR: METEO SIGNAL · 2';return '';}
function worldMiniInteract(){if(worldMini)return true;if(story.on||football||interior)return false;const p=actors[active],L=quickLocations();if(distance(p,L.kick)<6){if(active!==0){tip('Andrej izvodi slobodne udarce. Pritisni 1.',3);return true;}openWorldMini('kick');return true;}if(distance(p,L.signal)<6){if(r6.gateOpen){archive('meteo-arhiva-v6','Arhiva iza kapije','Telefon je uskladio frekvenciju, fazu i amplitudu sa starim prijemnikom. U arhivi je isti obrazac kao u svetlima Durmitorske.');tip('Kapija je otključana. Prijemnik je sačuvao tvoj signal.',4);return true;}if(active!==1){tip('Lazar dekodira signal na telefonu. Pritisni 2.',3);return true;}openWorldMini('signal');return true;}return false;}
function openWorldMini(type){if(!live||transition||worldMini)return;closeCinePanels();clearInput();if(document.pointerLockElement===scene)document.exitPointerLock();worldMini={type,core:type==='kick'?new KBQuickGames.FreeKick():new KBQuickGames.SignalLock(),wasPaused:paused,awarded:false};paused=true;$('betaPause').hidden=true;quick.hidden=false;$('r6QuickRole').textContent=type==='kick'?'ANDREJ / TEREN KOD GROBARSKOG':'LAZAR / TELEFON I STARI PRIJEMNIK';$('r6QuickTitle').textContent=type==='kick'?'Slobodni udarac u sumrak':'Dekodiranje meteo-signala';$('r6QuickFire').hidden=type!=='kick';$('r6QuickAgain').textContent=type==='kick'?'NOVA SERIJA':'NOVI POKUŠAJ';$('r6QuickHint').textContent=type==='kick'?'A/D ugao · W/S snaga · Q/E felš · Space šut':'←/→ frekvencija · A/D faza · W/S amplituda';syncQuickControls();initAudio();miniLast=performance.now();miniRaf=requestAnimationFrame(quickFrame);$('r6QuickClose').focus({preventScroll:true});}
function closeWorldMini(){if(!worldMini)return;const was=worldMini.wasPaused;worldMini=null;cancelAnimationFrame(miniRaf);quick.hidden=true;paused=was;clearInput();last=performance.now();accumulator=0;if(paused)$('betaPause').hidden=false;else scene.focus({preventScroll:true});updateHUD();}
function syncQuickControls(){const m=worldMini;if(!m)return;const wrap=$('r6QuickControls');wrap.replaceChildren();const specs=m.type==='kick'?[['power','Snaga',0.25,1,.01,100,'%'],['angle','Ugao',-18,18,.25,1,'°'],['lift','Visina šuta',8,25,.25,1,'°'],['spin','Felš',-1,1,.02,100,'%']]:[['frequency','Frekvencija',2,8,.01,1,' Hz'],['phase','Faza',0,Math.PI*2,.01,180/Math.PI,'°'],['amplitude','Amplituda',.25,1,.01,100,'%']];for(const [key,name,min,max,step,factor,unit]of specs){const label=document.createElement('label'),span=document.createElement('span'),output=document.createElement('output'),input=document.createElement('input');span.textContent=name;input.type='range';input.min=min;input.max=max;input.step=step;input.value=m.core[key];input.dataset.parameter=key;input.setAttribute('aria-label',name);const update=()=>{m.core[key]=+input.value;output.textContent=(key==='frequency'?(m.core[key]*factor).toFixed(2):Math.round(m.core[key]*factor))+unit;};input.oninput=update;label.append(span,output,input);wrap.append(label);update();}}
function quickKey(e,k){if(!worldMini)return false;if(k==='escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();closeWorldMini();return true;}if(k==='tab'){const fs=[...quick.querySelectorAll('button:not([hidden]),input')],first=fs[0],last=fs[fs.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}e.stopImmediatePropagation();return true;}if(['enter',' '].includes(k)&&e.target.closest?.('button')){e.stopImmediatePropagation();return true;}if(e.target.tagName==='INPUT'&&k.startsWith('arrow')){e.stopImmediatePropagation();return true;}e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();const a=worldMini.core;if(k===' '&&worldMini.type==='kick'){if(!e.repeat&&a.shoot())sound('kick');return true;}if(worldMini.type==='kick'){if(k==='a')a.angle=clamp(a.angle-.5,-18,18);if(k==='d')a.angle=clamp(a.angle+.5,-18,18);if(k==='w')a.power=clamp(a.power+.02,.25,1);if(k==='s')a.power=clamp(a.power-.02,.25,1);if(k==='q')a.spin=clamp(a.spin-.04,-1,1);if(k==='e')a.spin=clamp(a.spin+.04,-1,1);}else{if(k==='arrowleft')a.frequency=clamp(a.frequency-.02,2,8);if(k==='arrowright')a.frequency=clamp(a.frequency+.02,2,8);if(k==='a')a.phase=(a.phase-.04+TAU)%TAU;if(k==='d')a.phase=(a.phase+.04)%TAU;if(k==='w')a.amplitude=clamp(a.amplitude+.02,.25,1);if(k==='s')a.amplitude=clamp(a.amplitude-.02,.25,1);}for(const input of $('r6QuickControls').querySelectorAll('input')){input.value=a[input.dataset.parameter];input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));}return true;}
function quickFrame(ts){if(!worldMini)return;const m=worldMini,elapsed=document.hidden?0:Math.min(.1,(ts-miniLast)/1000);miniLast=ts;let rem=elapsed;while(rem>0){const dt=Math.min(1/60,rem);m.core.step(dt);rem-=dt;}if(ts-miniLastDraw<(document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')?30:14)){miniRaf=requestAnimationFrame(quickFrame);return;}miniLastDraw=ts;const cv=$('r6QuickCanvas'),rect=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')?1:1.5);if(cv.width!==Math.round(rect.width*dpr)||cv.height!==Math.round(rect.height*dpr)){cv.width=Math.max(2,Math.round(rect.width*dpr));cv.height=Math.max(2,Math.round(rect.height*dpr));}const c=cv.getContext('2d'),W=cv.width,H=cv.height;if(m.type==='kick')drawFreeKick(c,W,H,m.core);else drawSignalLock(c,W,H,m.core);
 if(ts-miniLastHud>90){miniLastHud=ts;if(m.type==='kick'){$('r6QuickScore').textContent='POKUŠAJ '+m.core.attempt+' / 5 · GOLOVI '+m.core.goals+' · POENI '+m.core.points;$('r6QuickClock').textContent='REKORD '+stateStore.get('kb_free_kick_best_v6',0);$('r6QuickMessage').textContent=m.core.message;$('r6QuickFire').disabled=m.core.phase!=='aim';if(m.core.phase==='over'&&!m.awarded){m.awarded=true;const best=stateStore.get('kb_free_kick_best_v6',0);if(m.core.points>best)stateStore.put('kb_free_kick_best_v6',m.core.points);if(m.core.goals>=2)archive('slobodnjak-v6','Slobodni udarci u sumrak','Andrej je pogodio '+m.core.goals+' od pet slobodnih udaraca. Preciznost i felš odlučili su seriju.');}}else{const a=m.core;$('r6QuickScore').textContent='STABILAN SIGNAL '+Math.floor(a.progress/2.5*100)+'%';$('r6QuickClock').textContent=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(a.duration-a.elapsed))+' s';$('r6QuickMessage').textContent=a.state==='decoded'?'SIGNAL DEKODIRAN · kapija je otključana':a.state==='expired'?'Veza je izgubljena. Pokušaj ponovo.':'Preklopi plavi talas sa zlatnim. Drži stabilnu vezu 2,5 sekunde.';if(a.state==='decoded'&&!m.awarded){m.awarded=true;r6.gateOpen=true;stateStore.put('kb_meteo_gate_v6',true);archive('signal-kapija-v6','Kapija meteo stanice','Lazar je uskladio frekvenciju, fazu i amplitudu signala. Stara kapija je otvorena.');r6.lightAt=-1;sound('clue');}}
 cv.dataset.type=m.type;cv.dataset.state=m.core.phase||m.core.state;cv.dataset.points=String(m.core.points||0);cv.dataset.progress=String(Math.round((m.core.progress||0)/2.5*100));}if((m.type==='kick'&&m.core.phase==='over'&&m.awarded)||(m.type==='signal'&&m.core.state!=='playing'&&(m.awarded||m.core.state==='expired'))){miniRaf=0;return;}miniRaf=requestAnimationFrame(quickFrame);}

 const person=(x,z,col)=>{const p=P(x,0,z),s=W*.9/(z+9);c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=s*.35;c.lineCap='round';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]-s*.7);c.lineTo(p[0],p[1]-s*1.4);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#d4b394';c.beginPath();c.arc(p[0],p[1]-s*1.65,s*.16,0,TAU);c.fill();for(const sign of [-1,1])line([x, .65,z],[x+sign*.22,.05,z],'#1c2e35',s*.10);};for(const x of [-1.1,0,1.1])person(x,9.8,'#a65f56');person(g.keeper.x,17.15,'#d9b875');for(let i=0;i<g.trail.length;i++){const b=g.trail[i],p=P(b.x,b.y,b.z);c.fillStyle='rgba(241,220,167,'+(i/g.trail.length*.5)+')';c.beginPath();c.arc(...p,2,0,TAU);c.fill();}const b=g.ball,p=P(b.x,b.y,b.z),shadow=P(b.x,0,b.z),r=W*.9/(b.z+9)*.22;c.fillStyle='#07191d66';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(...shadow,r*1.2,r*.45,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#f0e7cc';c.beginPath();c.arc(...p,r,0,TAU);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#1c343d';c.lineWidth=1;c.stroke();if(g.phase==='aim'){const a=g.angle*Math.PI/180,end=P(Math.sin(a)*3,.1,Math.cos(a)*3);c.strokeStyle='#f2d49b';c.setLineDash([5,5]);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...P(0,.1,0));c.lineTo(...end);c.stroke();c.setLineDash([]);}c.fillStyle='#0d202ddd';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H*.10);c.fillStyle='#e4ddc7';c.font='bold '+Math.max(10,W*.017)+'px Arial';c.textAlign='left';c.fillText('SUMRAK / GROBARSKO · 5 POKUŠAJA',W*.02,H*.065);}

let worldEvent=null,eventNext=42,eventHistory=stateStore.get('kb_cinema_events_v5',{}),eventSequence=0,accordionBeat=0;
function resetWorldEvents(){worldEvent=null;eventNext=time+35+Math.random()*35;$('cineEvent').hidden=true;}
function eventLabel(){if(!worldEvent)return '';if(worldEvent.type==='crash')return crashLabel();if(worldEvent.type==='derby')return worldEvent.state==='offer'?'PRIHVATI DERBI · E':'TEREN KOD GROBARSKOG · E';if(worldEvent.type==='accordion'&&distance(actors[active],LOC[3])<9)return cine?.recording?'SNIMAJ HARMONIKU · E':'UKLJUČI SNIMAČ · B';return '';}
function patrolPath(){if(part2)return part2.patrolPath();const ps=roadSegments.filter(s=>s.road.name==='Njegoševa').flatMap(s=>[s.a,s.b]).filter(p=>hyp(p[0]-PARK_POS.x,p[1]-PARK_POS.z)<200).sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);if(ps.length<2)return [];const from=clearSpot({x:ps[0][0],z:ps[0][1]},.8),to=clearSpot({x:ps[ps.length-1][0],z:ps[ps.length-1][1]},.8);return [from,...findPath(from,to).map(p=>({x:p[0],z:p[1]}))];}
function triggerWorld(type=null){if(!live||story.on||football||interior)return false;if(!missionScene)buildMissionScene();if(!cine)cine=newCine();if(worldEvent){tip('Prvo dovrši ili preskoči tekući događaj.',3);return false;}type=type||(part2?part2.pickEvent():['patrol','accordion','derby'][eventSequence++%3]);const p=actors[active];
 if(type==='derby'){worldEvent={type,state:distance(p,FIELD)<35?'offer':'approach',until:distance(p,FIELD)<35?time+42:Infinity,title:'NOĆNI DERBI NA MALE GOLIĆE',line:'Kosta: „Andrej, fališ za tri na tri. Do dva gola, pod sijalicom. E ako si za!“'};say('Kosta','Ekipo, tri na tri? De, da vidimo radi li taj šut posle mraka.',6);}
 else if(type==='crash'){if(!startCrash())return false;}
 else if(type==='patrol'){const path=patrolPath();if(path.length<2)return false;worldEvent={type,state:distance(p,path[0])<180?'active':'approach',title:'KOMISIJA / ČUDNA PATROLA',line:'Crni auto bez farova spušta se Njegoševom. Živa ograda i parkirani auto su zaklon. L: ugasi lampu. Z: čučni.',path,index:1,car:{...path[0],yaw:0},seen:0,hiddenTime:0,elapsed:0,caught:false};if(worldEvent.state==='approach')routeTo(path[0],true);else dayMode=3;say('Lazar','Crni auto, bez farova. U žbunje kod parka i gasi lampu. Samo nemoj da trčiš preko čistine.',7);}
 else {worldEvent={type:'accordion',state:distance(p,LOC[3])<80?'active':'approach',title:'HARMONIKE IZA STARE OGRADE',line:'Iza napuštenog dvorišta čuje se harmonika. B uključuje snimač. E uz ogradu započinje snimanje.',record:0,recording:false,started:time};routeTo(LOC[3],true);say('Pera','Je l’ ovo harmonika? Ta kuća je prazna otkad znam za sebe. Upali snimač.',6);}
 if(type==='patrol'&&part2)part2.prepareCover(worldEvent);eventNext=time+140+Math.random()*80;updateEventUI();return true;}
function resolveEvent(success,text){if(!worldEvent)return;const type=worldEvent.type;if(success){eventHistory[type]=(eventHistory[type]||0)+1;stateStore.put('kb_cinema_events_v5',eventHistory);if(type==='patrol')archive('j_komisija','Jedan od tri','Crni auto, sivi kaput, kreda na klupi i radio u kolima: „jedan od tri“. Neko je kvart podelio na tri tačke i prebrojava nas.');if(type!=='crash')archive('dogadjaj-'+type,{patrol:'Auto bez farova',derby:'Noćni derbi',accordion:'Harmonike iza stare ograde'}[type],text);}tip(text,6);worldEvent=null;eventNext=time+75+Math.random()*70;$('cineEvent').hidden=true;}
function eventInteract(){const e=worldEvent;if(!e)return false;if(e.type==='crash')return crashInteract(e);if(e.type==='derby'&&e.state==='approach'){routeTo(FIELD,true);tip('Kosta: Čekamo vas kod Grobarskog. E na terenu pokreće derbi.',4);return true;}if(e.type==='derby'&&e.state==='offer'){if(active!==0){tip('Andrej predvodi ekipu. Pritisni 1.',3);return true;}if(distance(actors[active],FIELD)>35){routeTo(FIELD,true);tip('Ekipa čeka na terenu kod Grobarskog. E uz teren.',4);return true;}e.state='playing';startFootball({street:true});return true;}if(e.type==='accordion'&&distance(actors[active],LOC[3])<9){if(active!==2){tip('Pera poznaje taj zvuk. Pritisni 3, pa B uključi diktafon.',4);return true;}if(!cine.recording){tip('B / SNIMAČ: prvo uključi snimanje zvuka.',3);return true;}e.recording=true;tip('SNIMANJE · ostani miran uz ogradu 10 s. Kretanje prekida čist snimak.',5);return true;}return false;}
function toggleRecorder(){if(!live||paused||football||mapOpen)return;if(!cine)cine=newCine();cine.recording=!cine.recording;sound('clue',.35);tip(cine.recording?'SNIMAČ UKLJUČEN · crvena tačka označava snimanje':'Snimač isključen',3);updateHUD();}
function updateWorldEvents(dt){if(story.on||football||interior||mapOpen)return;const p=actors[active],road=nearestRoad(p.x,p.z).road?.name||'';
 if(!worldEvent&&time>eventNext){const zone=/Njegoševa|Bubanjska|Durmitorska/.test(road)||inWood(p.x,p.z)||distance(p,PARK_POS)<75||distance(p,FIELD)<65;const nr=nearestRoad(p.x,p.z),street=!!nr.road&&nr.d<(nr.road.width||5)/2+2.5&&(nr.road.width||0)>=4&&!inWood(p.x,p.z)&&distance(p,PARK_POS)>40&&distance(p,FIELD)>50;if(street&&(!zone||Math.random()<.5)&&triggerWorld('crash')){}else if(zone)triggerWorld();else eventNext=time+12;}
 const e=worldEvent;if(!e)return;
 if(e.type==='crash'){updateCrash(dt,p);return;}
 if(e.type==='derby'){if(e.state==='approach'&&distance(p,FIELD)<35){e.state='offer';e.until=time+42;tip('Ekipa te je videla. E: prihvati derbi 3 na 3.',4);}if(time>e.until&&e.state==='offer')resolveEvent(false,'Ekipa je našla šestog igrača. Sledeći derbi čeka drugi put.');return;}
 if(e.type==='patrol'){
  if(e.state==='approach'){if(distance(p,e.path[0])<180){e.state='active';dayMode=3;}else return;}
  e.elapsed+=dt;const car=e.car,target=e.path[e.index];if(target){const L=distance(car,target),step=3.2*dt;if(L<=step){car.x=target.x;car.z=target.z;e.index++;}else {car.x+=(target.x-car.x)/L*step;car.z+=(target.z-car.z)/L*step;car.yaw=angleLerp(car.yaw,Math.atan2(target.x-car.x,target.z-car.z),dt*4);}}
  const hidden=part2?part2.isHidden(p,car):!torch&&!!cine?.crouch&&p.move<.65&&missionScene.bushes.some(b=>distance(p,b)<2.7),range=distance(car,p),visible=!hidden&&range<35&&lineClear(car,p,.13);
  if(hidden)e.hiddenTime+=dt;if(visible)e.seen=clamp(e.seen+dt*(torch?26:p.move>4?20:12),0,100);else e.seen=Math.max(0,e.seen-dt*15);e.hidden=hidden;
  if(e.seen>=100&&!e.caught){e.caught=true;e.line='Patrola te je primetila. Zaklon i ugašena lampa smanjuju sumnju. Izdrži do kraja prolaska.';sound('horn');say('Andrej','Videli su nas. Iza drvoreda! Ne preko puta!',5);}
  if(e.index>=e.path.length||e.elapsed>95)resolveEvent(!e.caught&&e.hiddenTime>=4,!e.caught&&e.hiddenTime>=4?'Patrola je prošla. Sakrio si ekipu bez traga svetlosti.':'Auto je otišao. Ekipa je bezbedna, ali čist prolazak nije zabeležen.');
 }else if(e.type==='accordion'){
  const dist=distance(p,LOC[3]);if(e.state==='approach'&&dist<80)e.state='active';if(e.state==='active'&&dist<65&&time>accordionBeat){accordionBeat=time+.36;accordionNote(dist);}
  if(e.recording){if(active===2&&cine.recording&&dist<9&&p.move<.8)e.record+=dt;else e.record=Math.max(0,e.record-dt*.6);if(e.record>=10){archive('ograda-tajni-dosije','Napušteno dvorište · poslednji takt','Na snimku harmonika svira i posle zatvaranja meha. U poslednjem taktu čuje se tihi glas: „Ne otvaraj ako ti odgovori tvoj glas.“');resolveEvent(true,'TAJNI DOSIJE OTKLJUČAN · poslednji takt je ostao na snimku.');}}
 }
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   NINDŽA MISIJA · SUDAR NA ULICI
   Slobodna šetnja: dva auta se sudare, vozači izađu i biju se.
   Crvena torba je ispala iz gepeka. Dok se biju, uzmi je neprimećen
   (Z čučanj, L lampa, kola kao zaklon, pazi kuda gledaju) i povuci se.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const crashCum=new WeakMap();
const crashWrap=a=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(a),Math.cos(a));
const crashInsults=['Gde ti je bio pogled, bre?!','Ti si ušao na moju stranu!','Platićeš mi branik, slepče!','Pa ja sam ti dao žmigavac!','Ko te učio da voziš?!','Ma šta me guraš, bre!','Pozvaću policiju, da znaš!','Aj izađi još jednom, ako smeš!'];
function roadCum(r){let c=crashCum.get(r);if(c)return c;c=[0];for(let i=1;i<r.p.length;i++)c.push(c[i-1]+hyp(r.p[i][0]-r.p[i-1][0],r.p[i][1]-r.p[i-1][1]));crashCum.set(r,c);return c;}
function roadAt(r,s){const c=roadCum(r),L=c[c.length-1];s=clamp(s,0,L);let i=1;while(i<c.length-1&&c[i]<s)i++;const seg=(c[i]-c[i-1])||1,t=clamp((s-c[i-1])/seg,0,1),a=r.p[i-1],b=r.p[i];return {x:lerp(a[0],b[0],t),z:lerp(a[1],b[1],t),yaw:Math.atan2(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])};}
function crashLoc(c,lx,lz){return {x:c.x+lx*Math.cos(c.yaw)+lz*Math.sin(c.yaw),z:c.z-lx*Math.sin(c.yaw)+lz*Math.cos(c.yaw)};}
function crashSite(p){
 const fx=Math.sin(yaw),fz=Math.cos(yaw);
 for(const AL of [30,19]){
  let best=null,bestScore=1e9;
  for(const r of roads){
   if(!r.p||r.p.length<2||(r.width||0)<4.2)continue;
   const cum=roadCum(r),L=cum[cum.length-1];if(L<AL*2+4)continue;
   for(let s=AL+2;s<=L-AL-2;s+=6){
    const q=roadAt(r,s),d=distance(p,q);if(d<36||d>92)continue;
    if(inWood(q.x,q.z)||pointInside(q.x,q.z,PARK.poly)||(Math.abs(q.x-FIELD.x)<FIELD.w/2+12&&Math.abs(q.z-FIELD.z)<FIELD.d/2+12))continue;
    const a=roadAt(r,s-AL),b=roadAt(r,s+AL);
    if(distance(p,a)<20||distance(p,b)<20)continue;
    if(Math.abs(crashWrap(a.yaw-b.yaw))>.55)continue;
    let ok=true;for(let u=-AL;u<=AL;u+=4){const w=roadAt(r,s+u);if(collide(w.x,w.z,.9)){ok=false;break;}}
    if(!ok)continue;
    const fwd=((q.x-p.x)*fx+(q.z-p.z)*fz)/d,score=Math.abs(d-55)/55-.35*fwd+Math.random()*.4;
    if(score<bestScore){bestScore=score;best={r,s,AL};}
   }
  }
  if(best)return best;
 }
 return null;
}
function startCrash(){
 const p=actors[active],site=crashSite(p);if(!site)return false;
 const {r,s,AL}=site,C=roadAt(r,s),a=roadAt(r,s-AL),b=roadAt(r,s+AL),fx=Math.sin(C.yaw),fz=Math.cos(C.yaw),nx=Math.cos(C.yaw),nz=-Math.sin(C.yaw);
 const paints=['#8a3b34','#3f5f78','#c8c2ad','#4d5b4a','#a9822f','#2e3338'],i0=Math.floor(Math.random()*paints.length),i1=(i0+2+Math.floor(Math.random()*3))%paints.length;
 /* Tuča je na strani ulice na kojoj si ti; torba je ispala sa druge strane kola. */
 const near=((p.x-C.x)*nx+(p.z-C.z)*nz)>=0?1:-1;
 const faceOff=sg=>{for(const lat of [3.1,2.3,1.6]){const x=C.x+nx*sg*lat,z=C.z+nz*sg*lat;if(!collide(x,z,.5))return {x,z,sg};}return null;};
 const M=faceOff(near)||faceOff(-near)||{x:C.x+nx*1.2,z:C.z+nz*1.2,sg:1};
 let bag=null;for(const [lat,al] of [[1.9,-3.0],[1.9,3.0],[1.55,-3.2],[1.55,3.2]]){const x=C.x-nx*M.sg*lat+fx*al,z=C.z-nz*M.sg*lat+fz*al;if(!collide(x,z,.3)){bag={x,z};break;}}
 if(!bag)bag={x:C.x-nx*M.sg*1.5-fx*3.2,z:C.z-nz*M.sg*1.5-fz*3.2};
 const A={x:a.x,z:a.z,yaw:a.yaw,paint:paints[i0],kind:'car',s:s-AL,dir:1,rest:C.yaw+.42,tilt:0,lean:0},B={x:b.x,z:b.z,yaw:b.yaw+Math.PI,paint:paints[i1],kind:'car',s:s+AL,dir:-1,rest:C.yaw+Math.PI-.5,tilt:0,lean:0};
 worldEvent={type:'crash',state:'approach',stage:'sneak',title:'SUDAR NA ULICI · NINDŽA ZADATAK',line:'Čuje se škripa guma niz ulicu. Pogledaj šta se dešava.',road:r,sC:s,AL,C:{x:C.x,z:C.z,yaw:C.yaw},n:{x:nx,z:nz},f:{x:fx,z:fz},M,carA:A,carB:B,t:0,elapsed:0,fightT:0,seen:0,grab:0,grabbing:false,item:false,alarm:false,alarmAt:0,caught:false,hidden:false,fighters:[],bag,showBag:false,nextInsult:0,nextHit:0,siren:false,result:null,endT:0,chase:0,sfx:[],introSaid:false};
 routeTo({x:C.x,z:C.z},true);
 say('Pera','Čuj ovo… škripa guma! Nešto ide niz ulicu, brzo!',5);
 return true;
}
function crashCollision(x,z,r){const e=worldEvent;if(!e||e.type!=='crash'||e.state==='approach'||e.state==='end')return false;
 for(const c of [e.carA,e.carB]){const dx=x-c.x,dz=z-c.z,cs=Math.cos(c.yaw),sn=Math.sin(c.yaw),side=Math.max(0,Math.abs(dx*cs-dz*sn)-.87),front=Math.max(0,Math.abs(dx*sn+dz*cs)-2.0);if(side*side+front*front<=r*r)return true;}
 return false;}
function crashPlaceCar(e,c){const q=roadAt(e.road,c.s);c.x=q.x;c.z=q.z;}
function crashImpact(e){
 const A=e.carA,B=e.carB;A.s=e.sC-2.15;B.s=e.sC+2.15;crashPlaceCar(e,A);crashPlaceCar(e,B);
 e.state='crash';e.t=0;e.showBag=true;e.smokeFrom=time;
 sound('bump',2.4,e.C);sound('flare',1.1,e.C);sound('horn',1.2,e.C);
 e.sfx.push([.22,'bump',1.6],[.55,'horn',.9],[1.0,'bump',.8]);
 e.line='SUDAR! Vozači izlaze iz kola. Torba iz gepeka je ispala na ulicu.';
 say('Lazar','Sudarili su se! Ne prilazi odmah, sačekaj da vidimo šta će.',4);
}
function crashSpawnDrivers(e){
 const looks=[{shirt:'#7a2f31',pants:'#232a33',hair:'#2b211b',skin:'#d1a07c'},{shirt:'#32506f',pants:'#1c1f24',hair:'#6b5a46',skin:'#c99575'}];
 e.fighters=[e.carA,e.carB].map((car,i)=>{const door=crashLoc(car,-1.35,.25),tgt={x:e.M.x+e.f.x*(i?.55:-.55),z:e.M.z+e.f.z*(i?.55:-.55)};
  return {i,x:door.x,z:door.z,yaw:Math.atan2(tgt.x-door.x,tgt.z-door.z),mode:'walk',target:tgt,door,seed:i*1.9+.7,gaze:0,p1:0,arm:0,hit:0,gone:false,faceYaw:i?e.C.yaw+Math.PI:e.C.yaw,...looks[i]};});
 sound('step',.5,e.C);
 say('Vozač','Slepče jedan, gde ti je pogled?!',3);
}
function crashDetect(e,p,dt){
 const crouch=!!cine?.crouch,lamp=!!torch,moving=p.move||0;
 const mult=(moving>4?42:moving>1.4?22:8)*(crouch?.5:1)*(lamp?2.4:1)*(1.18-.5*clamp(+dusk||0,0,1));
 const range=(e.alarm?30:23)+(lamp?7:0);let seen=false;
 for(const f of e.fighters){if(f.gone)continue;
  const r=distance(f,p),ang=Math.atan2(p.x-f.x,p.z-f.z),off=Math.abs(crashWrap(ang-f.gaze)),inCone=off<.78||r<3.2;
  f.sees=false;if(r<range&&inCone&&lineClear({x:f.x,z:f.z},p,.13)){f.sees=true;seen=true;e.seen=clamp(e.seen+mult*(1.25-r/range*.9)*(r<3.2?3:1)*dt,0,100);}}
 e.hidden=crouch&&!lamp&&moving<1.4;
 if(!seen)e.seen=Math.max(0,e.seen-12*dt);
 if(e.seen>=100&&!e.caught){
  e.caught=true;e.state='caught';e.chase=0;e.line='PRIMEĆEN SI! Vozači su te videli. Beži, ne daj da te stignu!';
  for(const f of e.fighters){f.mode='chase';}
  sound('horn',1.3,e.fighters[0]||e.C);say('Vozač','Ej! Ti tamo! Šta radiš kod mojih kola?! Stani!',4);
 }
}
function crashTake(e,p){
 e.item=true;e.grabbing=false;e.stage='escape';e.alarmAt=e.elapsed+5;sound('clue',1.3,e.bag);
 e.line='TORBA JE TVOJA. Povuci se bar 46 m od raskrsnice. Vozači će uskoro primetiti da je nema.';
 say('Lazar','Imamo je. Ne trči, ne pali lampu. Polako u senku.',5);
}
function crashFinish(e,ok,text){
 if(e.state==='end')return;
 e.result={ok,text};e.state='end';e.endT=0;
 for(const f of e.fighters){if(f.gone)continue;f.mode='back';f.target=f.door;}
 if(ok){
  archive('ulica-torba-sudar','Crvena torba sa raskrsnice','Unutra: mesingani ključ sa pločicom „KALAČ 7“, ogrlica sa šest uklesanih pseećih imena i fotografija vaše ekipe snimljena iz kola. Andrej, Lazar i Petar stoje u senci kod klupe. Na poleđini, rukom: „Tri su ostala. Ne zaključavaj kapiju.“ Kasnije, kad si se vratio na raskrsnicu, na asfaltu nije bilo nijednog traga kočenja.');
 }
}
function updateCrash(dt,p){
 const e=worldEvent;e.elapsed+=dt;
 for(const q of e.sfx){q[0]-=dt;if(q[0]<=0&&!q.done){q.done=true;sound(q[1],q[2],e.C);}}
 if(e.state==='approach'){
  e.t+=dt;
  if(e.t<1.4){if(e.t>.6&&!e.horn){e.horn=1;sound('flare',1.2,e.C);sound('horn',1,e.C);}return;}
  const sp=9.6;
  for(const c of [e.carA,e.carB]){
   c.s+=c.dir*sp*dt;const q=roadAt(e.road,c.s);c.x=q.x;c.z=q.z;
   const gap=Math.abs(e.sC-c.s)-2.15,swerve=gap<9?(1-Math.max(0,gap)/9)*.5*c.dir:0;
   c.yaw=angleLerp(c.yaw,(c.dir>0?q.yaw:q.yaw+Math.PI)+swerve,Math.min(1,dt*6));
   c.tilt=gap<4?-.04:0;
  }
  if(e.carA.s>=e.sC-2.15||e.carB.s<=e.sC+2.15)crashImpact(e);
  return;
 }
 /* Posle sudara: kola se ljuljaju, izlaze vozači. */
 for(const c of [e.carA,e.carB]){
  if(e.state==='end'&&e.endT>3.2){c.reverse=Math.min(8,(c.reverse||0)+dt*3);c.s-=c.dir*c.reverse*dt;crashPlaceCar(e,c);}
  else if(e.state!=='end'){c.yaw=angleLerp(c.yaw,c.rest,Math.min(1,dt*8));c.tilt=lerp(c.tilt,-.05,Math.min(1,dt*6));c.lean=lerp(c.lean,c.dir>0?.04:-.04,Math.min(1,dt*6));}
 }
 if(e.state==='crash'){
  e.t+=dt;
  if(e.t>2.3&&!e.fighters.length){crashSpawnDrivers(e);e.state='walk';}
  return;
 }
 /* Pokreti vozača. */
 let arrived=0;
 for(const f of e.fighters){if(f.gone)continue;
  if(f.mode==='walk'||f.mode==='back'){
   const L=distance(f,f.target),sp=f.mode==='back'?3.8:2.7;
   if(L>.14){const stepL=Math.min(L,sp*dt);f.x+=(f.target.x-f.x)/L*stepL;f.z+=(f.target.z-f.z)/L*stepL;f.yaw=angleLerp(f.yaw,Math.atan2(f.target.x-f.x,f.target.z-f.z),Math.min(1,dt*9));}
   else if(f.mode==='walk'){f.mode='fight';f.yaw=f.faceYaw;}
   else f.gone=true;
  }
  if(f.mode==='fight'||f.mode==='search')arrived++;
 }
 if(e.state==='walk'&&arrived===2){e.state='fight';e.fightT=0;e.line='TUČA! Torba je ispala pored kola, na drugoj strani. Dok se biju: čučni (Z), ugasi lampu (L), drži kola između sebe i njih i prati kuda gledaju.';
  say('Lazar','Dok se biju, torba je naša. Ninđa režim: čučni (Z), ugasi lampu (L) i prati im pogled. Kad se okrenu ka tebi — stani.',8);}
 /* Tuča, pogledi i udarci. */
 if(e.state==='fight'||e.state==='caught'){
  const A=e.fighters[0],B=e.fighters[1];
  if(e.state==='fight'){
   e.fightT+=dt;
   const sw=e.alarm?1.9:1.25,spd=e.alarm?1.5:.8;
   for(const f of e.fighters){if(f.gone)continue;f.gaze=f.faceYaw+sw*Math.sin(time*spd+f.seed*2.1);f.yaw=angleLerp(f.yaw,f.faceYaw,Math.min(1,dt*6));}
   if(!e.alarm){
    for(const f of e.fighters){const cyc=(time*1.05+f.seed)%1;f.p1=cyc<.28?Math.sin(cyc/.28*Math.PI):0;f.arm=Math.floor(time*1.05+f.seed)%2;f.sway=Math.sin(time*2.3+f.seed*4)*.12;}
    A.hit=B.p1;B.hit=A.p1;
    A.x=e.M.x+e.f.x*(-.55-A.sway*.35)+e.n.x*Math.sin(time*1.7)*.12;A.z=e.M.z+e.f.z*(-.55-A.sway*.35)+e.n.z*Math.sin(time*1.7)*.12;
    B.x=e.M.x+e.f.x*(.55+B.sway*.35)-e.n.x*Math.sin(time*1.7)*.12;B.z=e.M.z+e.f.z*(.55+B.sway*.35)-e.n.z*Math.sin(time*1.7)*.12;
    if(time>e.nextHit){e.nextHit=time+.52;sound(Math.random()<.5?'kick':'bump',.9,e.M);}
    if(time>e.nextInsult){e.nextInsult=time+7;tip('Vozač: „'+crashInsults[Math.floor(Math.random()*crashInsults.length)]+'“',2.6);}
   }else{
    for(const f of e.fighters){f.p1=0;f.hit=0;f.mode='search';}
   }
   /* Torba: E, pa ostani miran. */
   if(e.grabbing&&!e.item){
    const near=distance(p,e.bag)<3.4;
    if(!near){e.grabbing=false;e.grab=0;}
    else if((p.move||0)<1.0){e.grab+=dt;if(e.grab>=1.6)crashTake(e,p);}
    else e.grab=Math.max(0,e.grab-dt*1.5);
   }
   if(e.item&&!e.alarm&&e.elapsed>=e.alarmAt){e.alarm=true;e.line='Vozači su primetili da torbe nema! Gledaju oko sebe. Povuci se, ostani u senci.';say('Vozač','Čekaj… gde je torba?! Neko je bio kod kola!',5);}
   crashDetect(e,p,dt);
   if(e.state==='fight'){
    if(e.item&&distance(p,e.C)>46){crashFinish(e,true,'NINDŽA ZADATAK ZAVRŠEN · torba je kod tebe, a niko te nije video.');return;}
    if(e.fightT>62&&!e.siren){e.siren=true;sound('horn',.7,{x:e.C.x+e.f.x*80,z:e.C.z+e.f.z*80});tip('Čuje se sirena iz daljine. Imaš još oko 25 sekundi.',5);}
    if(e.fightT>88)crashFinish(e,e.item,e.item?'NINDŽA ZADATAK ZAVRŠEN · policija je stigla, a ti si već daleko sa torbom.':'Stigla je policija. Vozači su prestali da se biju, a torba je nestala sa ulice.');
   }
  }else{
   /* Poteru traje najviše 5,5 s. */
   e.chase+=dt;
   for(const f of e.fighters){if(f.gone)continue;const L=distance(f,p);f.yaw=angleLerp(f.yaw,Math.atan2(p.x-f.x,p.z-f.z),Math.min(1,dt*8));if(L>1.4){const sp=5.4*dt;moveBody(f,(p.x-f.x)/L*sp,(p.z-f.z)/L*sp,.38);}}
   const near=e.fighters.some(f=>!f.gone&&distance(f,p)<1.6);
   if(near){hurt=Math.max(hurt,.5);p.stamina=Math.max(9,(p.stamina||50)-14);crashFinish(e,false,'Vozač te je stigao i zgrabio. Torba ostaje kod njih, a ti si dobio samo modricu.');}
   else if(e.chase>5.5)crashFinish(e,false,'Primetili su te, ali si im se izmakao. Torba je ostala kod njih.');
  }
 }
 if(e.state==='end'){
  e.endT+=dt;
  if(e.endT>6.6)resolveEvent(!!e.result.ok,e.result.text);
 }
}
function crashLabel(){const e=worldEvent;if(!e||e.type!=='crash'||e.state!=='fight'||e.item)return '';const p=actors[active];if(distance(p,e.bag)>3.6)return '';return e.grabbing?'UZIMAŠ TORBU · ostani miran':'UZMI TORBU · E';}
function crashInteract(e){
 if(e.state!=='fight'||e.item)return false;
 const p=actors[active];if(distance(p,e.bag)>4.2)return false;
 if(distance(p,e.bag)>3.4){tip('Priđi bliže torbi. Ostani nisko i miran.',3);return true;}
 e.grabbing=true;tip('UZIMAŠ TORBU · ostani miran 1,6 s',2.5);return true;
}
function crashSmall(e){
 const p=actors[active];
 if(e.state==='approach')return 'Pogledaj niz ulicu · M: putanja';
 if(e.state==='crash'||e.state==='walk')return 'Sudar! Vozači izlaze iz kola…';
 if(e.state==='caught')return 'PRIMEĆEN SI · BEŽI!';
 if(e.state==='end')return 'Vozači se vraćaju u kola…';
 const sus='SUMNJA '+Math.round(e.seen)+'%'+(e.hidden?' · U ZAKLONU':''),police=e.siren?' · POLICIJA ZA '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil(88-e.fightT))+' s':'';
 if(e.item)return 'POVUCI SE · još '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil(46-distance(p,e.C)))+' m · '+sus+police;
 return (e.grabbing?'UZIMAŠ '+Math.round(clamp(e.grab/1.6,0,1)*100)+'% · ':'TORBA '+Math.round(distance(p,e.bag))+' m · ')+sus+' · Z čučanj · L lampa'+police;
}
/* ── Crtanje ── */
function crashCarModel(m,car){
 const b=Mesh();for(const side of [-1,1])for(const axle of [-1.23,1.19])carWheel(b,side*.81,axle,0);
 const Y=height(car.x,car.z)+.077;
